title: Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant — Cold Calling + Email Outreach
description:
We are a growing commercial cleaning company based in Los Angeles, California, and we’re looking for a highly motivated Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant in the Philippines to help us find and close new commercial cleaning clients.



This is not just a list-building or appointment-setting position. We want someone who can take ownership of the sales process from prospecting all the way through booking qualified opportunities for our cleaning team.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your primary goal is simple: help us book more commercial cleaning jobs in Los Angeles.



You will:



* Research and build targeted lists of businesses in Los Angeles

* Identify office buildings, property managers, businesses, and other companies that may need recurring commercial cleaning

* Find the correct decision-makers and their contact information

* Cold call businesses and introduce our cleaning services

* Send personalized cold
s and follow-ups

* Respond to interested prospects

* Follow up consistently with leads who don’t respond immediately

* Qualify opportunities and understand their cleaning needs

* Schedule estimates, walkthroughs, and sales calls

* Maintain an organized CRM/pipeline

* Move leads through each stage of the sales process

* Keep detailed notes on conversations and follow-ups

* Report on outreach, conversations, opportunities, and booked jobs



Who We’re Looking For



You should have:



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Clear, neutral pronunciation that is easily understood by U.S. prospects

* Confidence speaking with American business owners and decision-makers over the phone

* Previous experience with cold calling, outbound sales, appointment setting, or lead generation

* Strong
-writing skills

* Experience working with a CRM or sales pipeline

* The ability to stay organized and follow up relentlessly

* Strong research skills and the ability to build your own prospect lists

* A results-oriented mindset — we care about conversations, opportunities, and booked business, not just activity



Experience selling to U.S. businesses is strongly preferred.



Experience selling commercial cleaning, home services, property management, or other local services is a major plus.



What Success Looks Like



We don’t want someone who simply makes 50 calls and checks a box.



We want someone who thinks:



“How do I turn this company into a customer?”



If a prospect doesn’t answer, you follow up.



If they ask you to
 them, you send a strong
.



If they’re interested but not ready today, you put them into the pipeline and follow up at the right time.



If you notice a better type of company we should target, you tell us.



You’ll have ownership over your pipeline and will be expected to continuously move opportunities forward.



Schedule



You must be available to make calls during Los Angeles business hours (Pacific Time).



This is a long-term opportunity. We’re looking for someone who can grow with us and become an important part of our sales operation.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your sales experience

2. Your previous cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

3. What CRMs or sales tools you’ve used

4. Your experience working with U.S. clients

5. A 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself as if you were calling a Los Angeles business owner

6. Your availability during Pacific Time business hours



Please start your application with the word ASCEND so we know you read the full posting.



We’re looking for someone confident, hungry, organized, and comfortable hearing “no” without getting discouraged.



If you’re a strong communicator who enjoys sales and wants to directly contribute to growing a business, we’d love to hear from you.



Pay is $500 + commission on deal closed.

title: Wedding Culling and Editing
description:
We’re looking for a reliable photo culler and editor for ongoing remote work.



The workload is approximately four weddings per month, along with engagement sessions, surprise proposals, corporate events, and other portrait sessions.



The workflow includes:



• Run the initial cull through AfterShoot

• Review and refine the selections manually in Photo Mechanic or similar software

• Edit the selected photographs in Lightroom

• Select and edit sneak peeks with a fast turnaround

• Upload completed galleries to Pic-Time

• Keep all files and folders properly organized



We will provide starter Lightroom presets and examples of our editing style.



Requirements:



• Experience with AfterShoot, Photo Mechanic, Lightroom, and Pic-Time

• Good judgment when selecting images for focus, expressions, duplicates, and storytelling

• Wedding and event photography experience preferred

• Very fast and reliable internet for downloading and uploading large RAW files

• Fast, dependable communication

• Ability to follow our editing style and meet deadlines

• A computer capable of handling large photography projects



Starting rate is $5 per hour, with the potential for consistent ongoing work.



To apply, please send:



• Your experience with each program

• Your location and time zone

• Your availability

• Examples of your editing

• Your typical turnaround time for sneak peeks and a complete wedding

• Your internet download and upload speeds

title: PowerBi Developer
description:
If you do not have 5+ year's experience please do not apply for this role. 



The Dashboards and Analytics Analyst supports the business's day-to-day reporting needs, building and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports and visualisations that give Operations, Finance and Clinic Support teams reliable, accurate and easy-to-use insight into business performance.



This is a hands-on, BAU-focused role within a modern Azure-based data environment. The successful candidate will maintain and enhance the existing suite of Power BI dashboards, respond to reporting requests, and requires skills in DAX, Power Query and data modelling under the guidance of the Data Engineering team. 



Key Responsibilities

Dashboard Development & Maintenance

• Build, update and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, including standard DAX measures and calculations

• Perform continuous improvement and issue resolution on the current suite of dashboards, including documentation and bug fixes.

• Use Power Query and M-code for data preparation, transformation and automation of recurring reporting tasks.

• Work with data sourced from the Azure data warehouse, Microsoft Fabric to deliver reporting solutions.

• Partner with the Data Engineering team to understand data structures and escalate data quality issues promptly.



BAU Support & Governance

• Support monthly and quarterly reporting cycles, including data validation and reconciliations.

• Provide timely troubleshooting and production support for existing dashboards.

• Maintain clear documentation of report definitions, calculations and known issues.



Experience — Essential

• 5+ years' experience building Power BI reports, dashboards and visualisations, either in a dedicated BI role or as part of a broader analytics/finance/operations function.

• Working knowledge of DAX for standard measures and calculations.

• Experience with Power Query/M-code for data preparation and transformation.

• Basic to intermediate SQL skills, or a strong willingness to develop them.

• Good attention to detail and a methodical approach to data validation and reconciliation.

• Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain reporting issues or limitations to non-technical stakeholders.

description:

BrightNest Cleaning is a growing cleaning company serving residential and commercial clients with dependable cleaning services. As our customer base continues to grow, we are looking for a Customer Care Specialist who can help us provide a smooth and professional experience from the first customer inquiry through the completion of each service.

* Confirm upcoming appointments and send customer reminders.

* Contact leads who have requested information but have not yet booked.

* Keep customer profiles, notes, and appointment details up to date.

* Communicate special requests and customer instructions to the cleaning team.

* Monitor customer feedback and help resolve service-related concerns.

* Follow up with clients after appointments when necessary.

* Assist with basic billing and payment questions.

* Keep the inbox and customer communication channels organized.

* Escalate situations that require management attention.

* Maintain a positive and professional relationship with customers.

* Complete other administrative and customer-support tasks as assigned.

* Previous experience in customer support, virtual assistance, call center, or a similar role.

* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

* Confident and professional communication style.

* Ability to listen carefully and understand customer needs.

* Good judgment when handling complaints or unexpected situations.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to manage several conversations and tasks without losing track of details.

* Comfortable working with Google Workspace and online business tools.

 Schedule

BrightNest Cleaning is a growing residential and commercial cleaning company focused on providing reliable, professional service to our customers.



We are looking for a dependable Administrative Assistant to support our daily customer service and administrative operations. This position involves managing multiple tasks throughout the day, communicating with customers, coordinating bookings, maintaining CRM records, and following up with business owners and team members to make sure everything stays organized and on schedule.

* Respond to customer inquiries through phone,
, text, and other communication channels.

* Confirm appointments and communicate schedule changes to customers.

* Follow up with customers regarding inquiries, quotes, bookings, and service-related questions.

* Assist with general administrative and operational tasks as needed.

You will be expected to work confidently inside a **CRM system**, including updating customer profiles, entering notes, tracking leads, recording communication, managing follow-up tasks, and keeping appointment information accurate.



Experience with CRM platforms such as **GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan**, or similar systems is a strong advantage.

* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

* Experience answering inbound calls and handling customer inquiries.

* Experience with appointment booking and scheduling.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.

* Comfortable following up with customers, owners, managers, and team members.

* Experience using Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Calendar, or similar tools.

* Familiarity with scheduling and CRM software.

* Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

* Reliable internet connection and a suitable computer.

* Ability to work independently and take initiative.

* Monday–Friday

* Includes a 1-hour unpaid lunch break



The successful candidate must be available during working hours to answer customer calls, manage bookings, update the CRM, handle administrative requests, and communicate with the team.

**$1,600 USD per month**



This is a full-time position based on **40 hours per week**.



The compensation may be reviewed in the future based on performance, responsibilities, and growth within the company.



## What We Expect



We are looking for someone who is:



* Reliable and punctual.

* Organized and detail-oriented.

* Experienced with CRM systems.

* Comfortable managing multiple responsibilities.

* Professional and friendly when speaking with customers.

* Quick to respond to important requests.

* Good at following up and making sure tasks are completed.

* Comfortable taking initiative instead of waiting for instructions for every task.

* Able to communicate problems clearly and ask for help when necessary.

10. Confirmation that you can work **8 hours per day, Monday–Friday, during U.S. Central Time**.



**Please provide complete information in your application. Applications without relevant administrative, customer service, or CRM experience may not be considered.**

description:
I am looking for a highly organised, proactive, and detail oriented Executive Administrative Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of my personal brand. This is a critical role that allows me to focus on high-level client-facing work. You will be my right hand, ensuring that no lead is dropped, no meeting is double-booked, and my digital presence remains polished and consistent.

Inbox & Communication Management: 

Maintain a tidy, organised, and responsive inbox for both business and personal
. Respond to inquiries with high attention to detail and a professional tone.



Calendar & Scheduling: 

Manage a complex, fast-moving calendar. You must ensure zero scheduling conflicts, including coordination of professional meetings and personal events.



CRM & Nurture:

, and WhatsApp.



Logistics & Research:

Responsiveness: Inquiries must be handled fast (within 20 minutes).

Accuracy: Zero double-booked meetings and impeccably organized calendars.



Presence: 

Social media remains active, polished, and on-brand with regular, consistent updates.



Autonomy: You can work unsupervised, anticipate needs (especially regarding travel), and proactively manage the "behind-the-scenes" of the business.

Hours: 

2 hours per day, Monday–Friday (10 hours/week).

This is a remote, part-time position requiring high autonomy and trust.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

title: Creator Acquisition & Influencer Seeding Manager
description:
Creator Acquisition & Influencer Seeding Manager



TikTok | Instagram | UGC | Affiliate Recruitment



Natural Renewals is a growing U.S.-based health and wellness company and the company behind My Moss Sea Moss Gel.



We are looking for an experienced Creator Acquisition & Influencer Seeding Manager to help us aggressively expand our presence across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other social platforms.



This is NOT a traditional social media management position.



We are looking for someone who knows how to systematically find, recruit, seed and activate large numbers of creators.



Our goal is to build a creator acquisition engine capable of eventually getting our products into the hands of hundreds—and ultimately thousands—of qualified creators every week.



We are not looking for someone who simply sends a few influencer DMs each day.



We want someone who understands how to build a scalable creator outreach system.



YOUR PRIMARY OBJECTIVE



Build a repeatable system that takes creators through this funnel:



Creator Identified ? Contacted ? Responds ? Accepts Product ? Product Shipped ? Creator Posts ? Creator Becomes Affiliate ? Top Creators Become Long-Term Partners



We want to dramatically increase the number of creators talking about, reviewing, tasting and selling My Moss online.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Creator Research

Find qualified creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other platforms

Identify micro, mid-sized and larger creators who fit our customer demographic

Find TikTok Shop affiliates and creators who already promote consumer products

Identify creators producing content related to:

Health & wellness

Fitness

Nutrition

Food

Lifestyle

Beauty

Self-care

Natural products

Healthy living

Research creators working with competing or similar brands

Identify creators who regularly accept PR packages or create product-review content

Evaluate creators based on more than follower count

Creator Outreach

Contact large numbers of qualified creators every week

Use
, Instagram, TikTok and other appropriate outreach channels

Create outreach messages that generate responses

Personalize outreach where appropriate

Follow up consistently

Test different outreach messages and improve response rates

Track every creator contacted

Product Seeding

Get qualified creators interested in receiving free My Moss products

Collect shipping information

Collect product/flavor preferences

Coordinate approved shipments with our U.S. team

Maintain accurate records of every sample sent

Follow up after creators receive their products

Encourage authentic content creation

Affiliate Recruitment



We do not only want creators receiving free products.



We want to turn strong creators into long-term My Moss affiliates and brand partners.



You will help:



Recruit creators into our affiliate program

Identify creators capable of driving sales

Follow up with creators who receive product but have not posted

Encourage creators who perform well to create additional content

Identify high-performing creators for paid partnerships

Build long-term relationships with our strongest creators

Tracking & Optimization



You must be extremely organized.



We want to know:



How many creators were researched

How many creators were contacted

Response rate

Positive response rate

Number agreeing to receive product

Number of samples shipped

Number who actually posted

Posting rate

Videos/posts generated

Views generated

Engagement generated

Affiliates recruited

Sales generated where trackable

Cost per activated creator



You will provide a clear weekly report showing these numbers.



THIS IS A HIGH-VOLUME POSITION



We are not trying to build a small influencer program.



We want to build a large creator network.



Our long-term goal is to have thousands of creators receiving, discussing and selling My Moss products.



Initially, you may personally handle much of the research and outreach.



As the program grows, the right person may eventually help us:



Develop outreach systems

Create SOPs

Improve automation

Select creator research tools

Implement CRM systems

Hire and train additional creator outreach assistants

Manage additional creator researchers/outreach VAs

Scale creator acquisition into its own department



There is significant opportunity for growth for the right person.



WHO WE WANT



We want someone who has REAL experience with:



Influencer outreach

Creator seeding

UGC creator recruitment

TikTok creators

TikTok Shop affiliates

Instagram creators

Affiliate recruitment

Influencer databases

Creator relationship management



Experience with health, wellness, supplements, beauty, food, beverage or consumer packaged goods brands is strongly preferred.



You should also:



Have excellent written English

Understand U.S. social media culture

Be highly resourceful

Be comfortable reaching out to hundreds of people

Be persistent with follow-up

Be extremely organized

Understand spreadsheets and/or CRM systems

Be comfortable working independently

Understand creator metrics

Know how to recognize fake engagement

Know how to identify creators likely to actually post

Be comfortable being measured by results

WE DO NOT WANT



We are NOT looking for someone who:



Simply mass-DMs random accounts

Selects creators based only on follower count

Cannot explain creator funnel metrics

Has never run influencer outreach before

Sends generic spam messages

Cannot track outreach properly

Needs detailed instructions every day

Thinks activity is the same thing as results



Sending 5,000 DMs means nothing to us if none of those creators become productive relationships.



We care about activated creators.



HOW PERFORMANCE WILL BE MEASURED



Your primary KPIs will include:



Qualified Creators Sourced



Qualified Creators Contacted



Positive Responses



Creators Accepting Product



Samples Successfully Shipped



Creators Who Actually Post



Creator Posting Rate



Affiliate Creators Activated



Content Generated



Views / Engagement Generated



Sales Generated Where Trackable



Our goal is to continuously improve this funnel and increase creator acquisition every month.



PAID SKILLS TEST



We will NOT hire based solely on interviews.



The strongest applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical test.



We want to see how you actually work.



TEST 1 — FIND 50 CREATORS



Find 50 real U.S.-based creators that you believe Natural Renewals should contact for My Moss.



Divide your list into:



20 Micro Creators

15 Mid-Sized Creators

10 Affiliate/TikTok Shop Style Creators

5 Larger Creators



For every creator include:



Creator name

TikTok/Instagram/YouTube URL

Platform

Follower count

Average recent views

Estimated engagement

Content niche

Public
/contact information if available

Why this creator fits My Moss

Evidence that they create product-related content

Your estimated likelihood that they would accept product

Your estimated likelihood that they would actually create content

TEST 2 — PICK YOUR BEST 10



From the 50 creators you found, choose the 10 creators you would contact first.



Explain WHY.



We want to understand your decision-making.



Do not simply choose the 10 largest accounts.



TEST 3 — WRITE THE OUTREACH



Write personalized outreach messages for 10 of the creators.



Include outreach for:



Micro creators

Mid-sized creators

Larger creators

TikTok Shop/Affiliate creators



We want to see whether you understand that different creators require different approaches.



TEST 4 — BUILD THE FUNNEL



Natural Renewals wants to reach the point where we are shipping products to 2,000+ new qualified creators per month and continue scaling beyond that.



Show us how you would build the system.



Estimate:



Creators Researched



?



Creators Contacted



?



Responses



?



Positive Responses



?



Creators Providing Shipping Information



?



Products Shipped



?



Creators Posting



?



Creators Becoming Affiliates



Explain the assumptions behind your numbers.



TEST 5 — SCALE IT



Imagine the company tells you:



"We want to eventually reach thousands of creator contacts every week and hundreds of successful product seedings every week."



Explain:



What tools would you use?

What creator databases would you use?

How would you organize the operation?

What would you automate?

What should NOT be automated?

How many employees would eventually be needed?

What would each employee do?

How would you prevent quality from dropping as volume increases?

How would you increase creator posting rates?

How would you convert creators into affiliates?



There is no single correct answer.



We want to see whether you know how to think and operate at scale.



HOW TO APPLY



At the VERY beginning of your application, write:



“CREATOR MACHINE”



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered.



Then answer the following:



Tell us about your creator/influencer outreach experience.

What brands have you previously worked with?

What types of products were you promoting?

Approximately how many creators have you personally researched or contacted?

What is the largest creator outreach campaign you have worked on?

How many creators were you contacting per week?

What percentage responded?

What percentage agreed to receive product?

What percentage eventually posted content?

Have you recruited TikTok Shop affiliates?

Have you managed product seeding campaigns?

What tools have you used for creator discovery?

What tools have you used for creator outreach?

What CRM or tracking systems have you used?

How do you determine whether a creator is worth sending free product?

How do you identify fake followers or fake engagement?

How would you increase the percentage of seeded creators who actually post?

Have you ever managed other creator outreach employees or VAs?

What would you do during your first 30 days with Natural Renewals?

What monthly salary are you requesting?



Please include examples, screenshots, reports or measurable results from previous creator campaigns whenever possible.



Generic applications will not be considered.



We are looking for someone interested in helping us build this into a major long-term growth channel.



Strong performance can lead to increased compensation, additional responsibility and eventually leadership over a larger creator acquisition team.

title: Video Game Promoter
description:
Hello there!



I am hiring for a marketing and community outreach assistant for my indie MMORPG, RPG FX.



I am a US-based computer programmer building the game and engine myself, and I am looking for someone who can help promote the game, find interested players, grow our community, and get more people actually playing.



RPG FX is an online multiplayer RPG where players can explore, fight monsters, level up, collect items, and adventure together. The project is still growing, so this is a chance to get involved with a game fairly early and potentially take on a much bigger role as the community expands.







I am paying for this out of my own money, so the guaranteed base pay is currently only $5 per week, but the expected workload is also very small—around 20 minutes per day. There will also be bonuses based on successful promotion, player growth, and other measurable results.



What the job requires:



Find online communities and people who may be interested in indie MMORPGs and RPGs

Promote RPG FX through social media, 
 communities, forums, Reddit, and other appropriate places

Reach out directly to potential players, streamers, creators, and gaming communities

Come up with creative ideas for attracting new players

Track your outreach and results in a spreadsheet

Spend some time actually learning the game so you understand what you are promoting



I am ONLY interested in someone who already likes MMORPGs, RPGs, indie games, or online gaming communities.



This job is for someone who can work independently without needing constant supervision. I want someone who is smart, motivated, creative, and willing to experiment with different ways of finding players.



If your efforts successfully grow the game, this position has the opportunity to transition into significantly more hours, higher pay, and additional responsibilities involving marketing and community management.



Ryan

title: Facebook Ads Launcher - Execution only
description:
We’re a multi-brand e-commerce company running paid
 ad campaigns across several stores. We’re looking for someone to **launch
 ads in Ads Manager** based on instructions provided by our team.



That’s it.



This is a **long-term opportunity**, not a quick gig or one-off job. We’re hiring for consistency, reliability, and fast execution, with the goal of building a lasting working relationship.



## What You’ll Do



* Download creative + copy from a shared folder

* Copy/paste the provided ad copy into Ads Manager

* Upload the creative

* Set targeting, budget, and other settings exactly as instructed

* Review everything for accuracy

* Launch the ads



## What You Will NOT Do



* No ad killing or pausing

* No optimization

* No media buying decisions

* No strategy

* No creative edits

* No copywriting or copy edits



This is a **pure execution role**.



If you’re looking for a media buyer position where you’ll be making optimization or strategy decisions, this is **not** the position for you.



## Schedule & Availability



You must be **available every day of the week, Monday through Sunday**.



We may send ads to be launched on **any day of the week**, and you must be able to **launch them the same day they are assigned**.



Fast turnaround is extremely important for this role.



Current workload is approximately **1–2 hours per day when launches are required**, but this can increase to **2–4+ hours as our ad volume and number of brands grow**.



Your daily workload may vary. Some days may have fewer ads, while other days may have significantly more.



## Requirements — ALL Mandatory



* Prior experience launching
 ads directly inside Meta Ads Manager

* Available **7 days per week**

* Able to launch ads **the same day they are assigned**

* Comfortable working across multiple ad accounts and brands

* Able to follow detailed instructions exactly without making unauthorized changes

* Reliable and responsive

* Very detail-oriented — mistakes with URLs, copy, creative, budgets, targeting, naming, or settings are not acceptable

* Able to work quickly while maintaining accuracy

* Looking for a **long-term commitment**, not a short-term or one-time gig

* Rate is **$3/hour** — you must be completely comfortable with this rate before applying



## To Apply



Use the subject line:



**“I meet all requirements”**



Only use this subject line if you **100% meet every requirement above**.



In your application:



1. Confirm **one by one** that you meet EACH requirement listed above.

   No partial matches, no “I can adjust my schedule,” and no exceptions.



2. Tell me:



   * Approximately how many
 ads you have launched

   * How many different ad accounts/brands you have worked with

   * How long you have been doing this type of work



3. Explain what your previous ad-launching process looked like from the moment you received the creative/copy until the ad was published.



4. Answer this in **one sentence only**:



**What is the difference between a campaign, an ad set, and an ad?**



**Do not use ChatGPT or AI to write your application or answer the question above. Generic or AI-generated applications will be rejected.**

title: SEO & Online Visibility Specialist – Google, Reddit, TikTok & AI Search
description:
Natural Renewals is a growing U.S.-based health and wellness company and the company behind My Moss Sea Moss Gel. We are looking for a smart, resourceful and highly motivated SEO & Online Visibility Specialist to help us dramatically increase our presence across the internet.



This is not a position where we simply need someone to write a few blog posts every month.



We want someone who is constantly looking for opportunities to get Natural Renewals and My Moss discovered across Google, Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, AI search engines, directories, blogs, websites and other online platforms.



Your main goal will be simple:



Help more people discover our brand when they search for sea moss, sea moss gel, health foods and related products online.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for activities including:



Perform SEO and keyword research for our website and products

Identify keywords we should be ranking for on Google

Improve existing website pages for SEO

Research opportunities for backlinks and brand mentions

Submit our company to relevant legitimate directories and websites

Find blogs, websites, publications and communities where our company can be featured

Research relevant Reddit conversations and opportunities for Natural Renewals to participate

Help increase our visibility in Reddit and Google search results

Research TikTok, YouTube and social-media search trends related to sea moss and health foods

Identify questions and topics consumers are actively searching for

Help optimize our content for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other platforms

Research ways to improve how Natural Renewals/My Moss appears in ChatGPT, Google AI, Perplexity and other AI-powered search tools

Find websites and online resources where our brand should be mentioned

Perform competitor research and identify where competing sea moss brands are getting traffic, links and exposure

Conduct outreach to bloggers, websites, publications and potential partners

Maintain spreadsheets documenting outreach, backlinks, brand mentions and SEO opportunities

Monitor keyword rankings and traffic

Provide a short weekly report showing exactly what was completed, what changed and what opportunities were discovered

What We Are Looking For



We want someone who is:



Extremely resourceful

A strong internet researcher

Comfortable working independently

Excellent at written English

Familiar with SEO and digital marketing

Comfortable using AI tools for research and productivity

Familiar with Google Search Console and keyword research tools

Familiar with Reddit, TikTok, YouTube and social platforms

Able to find opportunities without constantly being told what to do

Organized and able to document their work

Interested in growing with a U.S.-based company long term



Experience with e-commerce, health/wellness brands, food brands or consumer products is a major plus.



IMPORTANT



We are not looking for spam.



We do not want thousands of low-quality backlinks, fake reviews, fake customer testimonials, automated comments or copied AI articles.



We want someone who understands how to create real online authority and visibility.



Quality matters more than quantity.



PAID TEST



Applicants who make the shortlist may be asked to complete a small paid test.



The test may include:



Reviewing our website

Identifying SEO opportunities

Finding keywords we should target

Finding places online where our brand could gain legitimate exposure

Identifying Reddit/TikTok/Google opportunities

Showing us what you would focus on during your first 30 days

HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your SEO experience.

Examples of websites or brands you have helped grow.

SEO tools you have experience using.

Your experience with Reddit, TikTok or social-search optimization.

Your experience with backlinks and outreach.

Any experience you have with AI search/GEO.

Your expected monthly salary for 20–25 hours per week.



At the beginning of your application, write the words "MY MOSS" so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Outbound Appointment Setter
description:
Cold/Lukewarm Calling • Part-Time • Long-Term Opportunity



We're hiring an Outbound Appointment Setter to contact U.S. homeowners and schedule Mortgage Protection Reviews.



This is not a traditional VA position. This is a performance-driven calling role.



We're looking for someone who:



- Speaks excellent, conversational English

- Has a confident, professional phone voice

- Has previous cold-calling/outbound experience

- Is comfortable making 300–400 manual calls per day (certain days)

- Is reliable, coachable and competitive

- Is ready to get on the phones and learn through execution



We provide the leads, scripts, systems, training, coaching and support.



Our philosophy is simple: YOU LEARN BY DOING



Training is approximately 20% instruction/role-play and 80% live calling with real-time coaching.

You don't need to be perfect. You do need to execute, accept feedback and improve quickly.



YOUR ROLE:

You'll contact homeowners who recently obtained a mortgage and schedule a Mortgage Protection Review with a licensed specialist.

You are NOT selling insurance.

Your job is to turn conversations into qualified appointments, ideally within approximately 3 minutes.

Calls are manually dialed through GoHighLevel — no auto dialer or power dialer.



SCHEDULE *IMPORTANT*



Primary dialing days:



MONDAY + THURSDAY

Approximately 16-20 hours/week



Required peak hours:



7:30–9:30 AM Central Time

4:00–8:00 PM Central Time



These hours are non-negotiable and produce the majority of our appointments.



If another job, school or commitment prevents you from consistently working these hours, please do not apply.



PERFORMANCE



Our initial target is: 16 qualified appointments per Monday/Thursday dialing cycle.



We're looking for production, reliability and improvement, not someone who simply logs hours.



Final candidates will complete a 3-day paid working trial:



Training ? Role Play ? Live Calls ? Coaching ? More Calls



We'll evaluate your communication, reliability, coachability, resilience and ability to produce appointments.



Strong performers can earn additional hours, performance bonuses and greater responsibility as the team grows.



WHO SHOULD APPLY?



You'll fit well if you're:

- Competitive. Coachable. Reliable. Energetic. Resourceful.

- You don't need to feel 100% ready before taking action.



Your mentality is: FIGURE IT OUT ? ASK ? LEARN ? EXECUTE.



HOW TO APPLY: 

- Do NOT send a generic application or a dead résumé.

- Send a 60–90 second audio recording answering:



1. What outbound/cold-calling experience do you have?

2. What campaigns or industries have you called for?

3. Are you available every Monday & Thursday during BOTH required peak windows?

4. What's the most outbound calls you've made in one day?

5. Why would you perform well in this role?



Voice recording required. Applications without one will not move forward.



We're beginning paid auditions immediately.

title: Client Success Specialist - US Fintech | Fixed 4AM-12PM Thu-Mon | $930 USD/mo
description:
THE SHORT VERSION: You'll own every client conversation that lands in our Slack between 4:00 AM and 12:00 PM your time, five days a week, for a US financial-technology company whose clients are American business owners. It's our US evening shift - which means it's a MORNING shift for you. No graveyard. Fixed schedule. Weekends are workdays; Tuesday and Wednesday are your days off.



ABOUT US: Dividend Shift is a growing US company in crypto payment processing. Our clients are US entrepreneurs building payment-terminal businesses, and they message us at night and on weekends - exactly when you'll be on. You'll work directly with the founder and a small senior team on Slack. No agency in the middle, no bureaucracy, fast decisions. This is a foundational hire: you'll be our first dedicated evening/weekend Client Success Specialist, with a real path to senior CS as we grow.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN ON EVERY SHIFT:

- Answer every client message in our Slack workspace within 15 minutes - that's the house standard and the heartbeat of this job

- Support clients who are in live business meetings and need a fast, accurate answer right now

- Collect client scheduling availability each evening and hand the team a complete list before end of shift

- Triage after-hours intake forms and support
s so nothing waits overnight

- Acknowledge and log urgent complaints, and escalate them properly (you'll never be asked to make policy decisions alone)

- Confirm tomorrow's client calls and follow up with today's no-shows

- Light admin between messages: shipment tracking updates, CRM notes, review requests, and a short end-of-shift report



NON-NEGOTIABLES - READ THESE BEFORE APPLYING:

- Every Saturday and Sunday is a workday. Your days off are Tuesday and Wednesday. If weekends are a dealbreaker, this role is not for you - no exceptions, no rotation.

- The shift is FIXED: Thursday-Monday, 4:00 AM-12:00 PM Philippine time. Each November-March it shifts to 5:00 AM-1:00 PM when US clocks change.

- 15-minute response standard while on shift. This is an active, at-your-desk role - not a "check it sometimes" night gig.

- Excellent written English. Most of the job is writing to American clients who are sometimes stressed. Warm, clear, professional writing is the core skill.

- Fiber internet with a backup connection AND a backup power plan for brownouts.

- No other job or clients during shift hours. Own reliable laptop.



PAY AND TERMS: $930 USD/month all-in - $800 base + $100 weekend-shift differential + $30 internet allowance - paid in USD, monthly. Performance bonus potential after your first 30 days. Direct long-term independent-contractor agreement with the company (no agency taking a cut).



OUR TIMELINE - WE MOVE FAST: We hire within 7 days of posting. Application (about 15 minutes - it IS the first interview), then a 20-minute video interview, then a short PAID trial task, then offer and start.



HOW TO APPLY - IMPORTANT:

Apply ONLY through this form: 



The form asks specific questions for a reason, including a 60-90 second voice recording - have a quiet spot ready. If you cannot complete it fully, out of respect for your time, please don't start it, as we won't reach out. Applications sent as OnlineJobs.ph messages are not reviewed.



One more thing: the last question of the form asks for a code word. The code word is SUNRISE - now we know you actually read this.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Takes pride in their work and pays attention to the small details

Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling

Knows how to edit content for performance, engagement, and conversions

Can adapt to different creative styles: nostalgic, Y2K, raw footage, organic, etc.

Willing to put in the extra effort to make an edit actually hit

Can think independently instead of relying on step-by-step instructions

Brings their own creative ideas and suggestions to the table

Takes feedback well and improves with every revision

Must be comfortable editing in CapCut



THE TYPE OF CONTENT

TikTok / Reels-style short-form content

Paid ads + organic content

Product-focused storytelling

Hook-driven, fast-paced, high-retention edits

Nostalgic, raw, real-life aesthetics

Content that feels native to social media—not overly polished or corporate



YOU’RE NOT A FIT IF YOU

Rush edits just to deliver them quickly

Throw clips together without thinking about the final result

Need every detail explained before you can execute

Use the same editing style for every piece of content

title: Wedding Video Editor — Long-Term Remote Position
description:
Rock Penguin Media is looking for a skilled and reliable wedding video editor to join our team long-term.



This is **NOT a beginner position.**



We are looking for an editor who understands cinematic wedding storytelling, pacing, music, audio, color grading, and how to create an emotional film that keeps the viewer engaged from beginning to end.



You must be comfortable creating 6–12 minute wedding highlight films without losing the story, pacing, or viewer's attention.



The Position



This is a remote, long-term role with consistent work for the right editor who communicates well.



Most projects will be weddings, but projects may also include engagement and proposals. 



Each standard project will typically include:



* 1 trailer

* 1 highlight film

* 3 social media reels

* 1 ceremony edit (often, but not every wedding)



Highlight Wedding films will generally range from 6–12 minutes, depending on the wedding and project.



Some projects may also include:



* Reception edits

* Speech/toast edits

* Other documentary-style edits



Editing Style & Experience



We want someone who understands how to tell the full story of a wedding day, rather than simply placing pretty clips over music.



Because we work with multiple filmmakers and associates, footage will come from **different shooters, camera systems, shooting styles, and experience levels**.



We are looking for an editor who can recognize the strongest footage available, work creatively around imperfections when necessary, and maintain consistent storytelling, color, pacing, and overall quality across projects.



You should be comfortable with:



* Multi-camera wedding footage

* Footage from multiple shooters and varying experience levels

* Different cameras, picture profiles, and shooting styles

* Syncing external audio

* Using vows and speeches to build a story

* Music selection and pacing

* Natural audio and sound design

* Color correction and grading

* Matching footage between different cameras

* Working creatively around imperfect footage when necessary

* Creating seamless transitions

* Working with drone footage

* Creating both cinematic and documentary edits

* Selecting the strongest footage from a large amount of raw footage

* Creating short-form social media edits from the same wedding

* Maintaining a consistent final product regardless of who filmed the project



**DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro are our preferred editing software.**



Experience editing Arab, Persian, Indian, Pakistani, South Asian, or other multicultural weddings is a major bonus.



If you have this experience, please specifically mention it in your application and provide examples.



Compensation



**$700 USD per month for 4 completed projects**, paid on the 15th of each month.



Standard projects include the teaser, highlight film, 3 reels, and ceremony edit when applicable.



Documentary Edit Pay



Projects requiring additional documentary edits will receive an additional **$85 USD per qualifying project** on top of your monthly compensation.



For example, if one of your four projects that month includes a qualifying documentary edit, your compensation for that month would be **$785 USD**.



Compensation includes reasonable revisions necessary to complete each standard project. 



How to Apply — FOLLOW DIRECTIONS CAREFULLY



Respond with the subject line:



**"I want to work for you Victoria"**



Your application MUST include:



1. Name

2.

3. Phone number / WhatsApp

4. Operating System — Mac and PC are both accepted

5. Editing Software

6. Links to at least 3–5 recent wedding films that YOU personally edited, with 1–2 being films longer than 6 minutes.

7. Tell us whether you have experience editing Arab, Persian, Indian, Pakistani, South Asian, or multicultural weddings.

8. If yes, include at least one example.

9. Tell us about your experience creating 6–12 minute wedding highlight films.

10. Tell us about your experience editing multi-camera footage and syncing/working with external audio.

11. Tell us about your experience working with footage from multiple shooters and varying skill/experience levels and how you maintain consistency in the final film.

12. Tell us your typical turnaround time for a full wedding project.



Internet Speed Test



Please send a video recording of your Wi-Fi/internet speed test using Speedtest.net.



Run the test once, refresh the page, and run it a second time. Your video should show both tests.



IMPORTANT



If you do not follow the application instructions, your message will be ignored.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a reliable, long-term part of Rock Penguin Media's editing team not someone looking for occasional one-off projects.

title: Short Form Video Editor for Music Artist
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are looking for a highly creative Short Form Video Editor to work long term with an independent Christian hip hop artist.



This role is focused specifically on editing social media content.



You will not be responsible for managing social media accounts, answering comments, running ads, or handling marketing operations.



Your job is to take raw footage and turn it into fast paced, current, highly engaging short form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
 Reels.



THE STYLE WE NEED



We are looking for someone who understands:



• Gen Z content



• Fast paced short form editing



• Retention focused editing



• Strong first second hooks



• Platform native TikTok and Instagram editing



• Music culture



• Hip hop culture



• Memes and internet culture



• Pattern interruptions



• Creative subtitles and text



• Sound effects



• Music synchronization



• Visual storytelling



• Organic looking edits



• High energy edits



• When to heavily edit a video and when to keep it simple



You should understand what content looks like right now, not what social media videos looked like three years ago.



We need edits that are built to compete for attention on modern social platforms.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



Our content library includes:



• Music videos



• Performance footage



• Studio footage



• Vlogs



• Behind the scenes content



• Interviews



• Lifestyle footage



• Gaming content



• Talking videos



• Long form videos



• Promotional music content



• Release content



You should be able to take longer footage and independently identify moments that can become strong short form videos.



We do not want to provide timestamps for every edit.



Part of your value should be recognizing what the content is.



CREATIVE REFERENCES



You should study content from artists such as:



• Miles Minnick



• Hulvey



• Lecrae



• Caleb Gordon



• Alex Jean



These are references for understanding the Christian hip hop market, culture, artist presentation, and content ecosystem.



However, we DO NOT want the content limited to Christian hip hop references.



You should also regularly study mainstream hip hop artists, creators, streamers, entertainment accounts, meme culture, TikTok trends, and other high performing social media content.



We want to take what is working across internet culture and creatively adapt it to a Christian hip hop artist without simply copying other people.



THIS IS NOT CORPORATE VIDEO EDITING



Please do not apply with a portfolio primarily consisting of:



• Real estate videos



• Restaurant content



• E commerce advertisements



• Corporate videos



• Basic podcast clips



• Talking head videos with automatic captions



• Generic business Reels



• Template based edits



Those examples do not help us evaluate whether you are right for this position.



We are specifically looking for music, artist, creator, entertainment, Gen Z, culture driven, or highly creative short form editing.



EXPERIENCE



Direct music industry experience is preferred but NOT required.



We care more about your creative ability than your resume.



If you are extremely talented at editing but have not had the opportunity to work with artists professionally yet, you are still encouraged to apply.



If your portfolio does not currently demonstrate this exact style but you believe you have the technical and creative ability to execute it, we may invite you to complete a paid test edit using our footage.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST



We want someone who:



• Has excellent creative instincts



• Understands current social media culture



• Watches Reels and TikTok enough to know what is actually trending



• Is strong in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, or similar software



• Can edit quickly without sacrificing quality



• Understands hooks and retention



• Can recognize good moments inside raw footage



• Can bring their own ideas to an edit



• Does not need every transition, sound effect, caption, or cut explained to them



• Takes feedback well



• Communicates consistently



• Meets deadlines



• Wants a long term position rather than a temporary editing project



This position will initially be approximately 10 to 15 hours per week, with the opportunity for more work as the relationship and artist continue to grow.



IMPORTANT QUALITY STANDARD



We are not hiring simply because we need more editing capacity.



We are hiring because we want to improve the quality of the content.



Our artist already has professionally edited social media and music content.



The person we hire needs to be capable of eventually producing content that is at least at our current level and ideally better.



If modern music artist content, Gen Z editing, TikTok culture, and creative short form videos are not your strengths, this will probably not be the right position for you.



HOW TO APPLY



Please create ONE Google Drive folder and send us the link.



Your folder should contain:



1. Your Best 3 to 5 Relevant Videos



Only include examples that represent the type of editing we are hiring for.



We would rather see three incredible edits than twenty average ones.



Please prioritize:



• Music content



• Artist content



• Creator content



• Gen Z content



• Entertainment content



• Fast paced short form videos



• Creative social media edits



Please DO NOT fill the folder with unrelated business or corporate work.



2. Short Introduction



Include a short document answering:



Why does this specific position interest you?



What type of content do you personally enjoy editing?



Which creators or artists do you currently think have some of the best short form content?



What editing software do you use?



How many hours per week are you currently available?



3. Portfolio



You may also include your full portfolio if you have one, but make sure the 3 to 5 relevant videos are easy for us to find first.



NEXT STEP



Shortlisted applicants will receive additional information about the artist and current social media content.



At that stage, we will evaluate whether your creative style fits what we are building.



Some applicants may also be invited to complete a paid test edit.



We are looking for someone creative, hungry, current, dependable, and interested in building with us long term.
