title: Estimator
description:
REMOTE CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATOR

Philippines-Based | Full-Time | U.S. Commercial Construction



Oceanview Building Group is a South Florida general contractor specializing in premium healthcare interiors, including dental offices, medical clinics, and cosmetic surgery facilities.



We are looking for an experienced Construction Estimator, who can independently prepare accurate takeoffs, detailed estimates, subcontractor scopes, and bid comparisons for U.S. commercial construction projects.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who understands construction drawings, knows how projects are built, and can identify missing scope before it becomes a costly change order.



Key Responsibilities



* Review architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection drawings.

* Complete accurate quantity takeoffs and detailed cost estimates.

* Develop scopes of work organized by CSI division and trade.

* Prepare subcontractor bid packages and invitations to bid.

* Review, compare, and level subcontractor proposals.

* Identify exclusions, missing scope, drawing conflicts, and constructability concerns.

* Request pricing from subcontractors and suppliers.

* Prepare conceptual budgets when drawings are incomplete.

* Maintain estimating templates, historical pricing, and subcontractor databases.

* Assist with value engineering and cost-saving recommendations.

* Prepare clear estimate summaries for management review.

* Support project handoff from estimating to operations.



Required Qualifications



* At least 4 years of construction estimating experience.

* Experience estimating U.S. commercial interior construction projects.

* Strong ability to read and interpret complete construction documents.

* Working knowledge of architectural and MEP trades.

* Experience preparing detailed takeoffs—not just collecting subcontractor prices.

* Proficiency with Bluebeam and takeoff or estimating software such as PlanSwift, STACK, or similar.

* Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to meet deadlines.

* Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote workspace.

* Ability to work hours that overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.



Preferred Experience



* Healthcare, dental, medical office, surgical facility, or laboratory construction.

* South Florida or other U.S. commercial construction markets.

* Buildertrend or similar construction-management software.

* Subcontractor solicitation and bid leveling.

* Creating estimating systems, templates, and cost databases.



What Success Looks Like



* Estimates are complete, organized, and easy to review.

* Quantities are supported by documented takeoffs.

* Scope gaps and conflicts are identified before bidding.

* Subcontractor proposals are properly compared and leveled.

* Deadlines are met without sacrificing accuracy.

* Projects are handed to operations with clear scopes and budgets.



Application Requirements



Please submit:



1. Your résumé.

2. A brief description of the U.S. commercial projects you have estimated.

3. A sample takeoff, estimate, or bid-leveling sheet with confidential information removed.

4. The estimating software you use.

5. Your expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos.

6. Your availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours.



Selected candidates will complete a paid estimating test using a small commercial construction plan set.



Employment Type: Full-time, long-term remote position

Location: Philippines

Schedule: Monday through Friday with U.S. Eastern Time overlap

Company: Oceanview Building Group

title: AI Video Creative Specialist – Direct Response Dropshipping Ads
description:
# AI Video Creative Specialist – Direct Response Dropshipping Ads



**Starting Salary: $700 USD/month**

**Salary review and increase after 3 months based on performance**



**Schedule: Monday – Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM | Full-Time**



---



## About Us



We are a fast-growing **pure dropshipping company** specializing in men's products.



We are **not a traditional e-commerce brand**.



Our business model is based on constantly researching, testing and scaling new products through paid advertising.



Every week, our team identifies products with potential.



We provide the products, the target audiences and the information you need.



Your job is to take those products and audiences and create **high-converting video advertising creatives** specifically for
 and Instagram.



This is a **direct-response advertising position**.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to make beautiful videos.



We need someone who understands:



**Product + Audience + Marketing Angle + Creative + Conversion**



The purpose of every video is ultimately to **make the customer want the product and take action.**



---



# THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL VIDEO EDITING JOB



This is extremely important.



We are **not hiring someone to make nice-looking videos just for the sake of making videos.**



We need someone who understands how to use video to **market and sell products.**



A beautiful video that gets attention but does not make someone interested in buying is not a successful creative for us.



You need to understand:



* Who the target customer is

* What the customer wants

* What problem or desire the product addresses

* What angle will attract that customer

* What will make someone stop scrolling

* How to present the product quickly

* How to create desire

* How to make the product look appealing

* How to create a reason to continue watching

* How to turn attention into purchasing intent



You are creating **advertising creatives**, not entertainment content.



---



# YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY



Every week, our team will provide you with new products that have **potential to be scaled through paid advertising**.



We will also provide information about the target audiences we are testing.



You will be responsible for understanding the product and audience and creating multiple AI-powered video creatives designed specifically to attract those customers.



Videos will generally be:



**12–15 seconds long.**



Your target production volume will be approximately:



**20+ usable advertising creatives per day.**



The objective is to give our Meta Ads team a large number of strong creatives that they can test and use to identify winning angles.



---



# WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities include:



* Create 20+ usable video advertising creatives per day.

* Create videos specifically for *
 and Instagram advertising**.

* Study the product before creating the creative.

* Understand the target audience for each product.

* Develop different marketing angles for the same product.

* Use AI tools to create product-focused videos.

* Create different hooks and concepts.

* Create different visual presentations of the same product.

* Create videos designed to stop the scroll.

* Create videos designed to generate purchasing interest.

* Keep the product as the main focus.

* Make sure the product remains accurate and recognizable.

* Review every video before submission.

* Organize completed creatives properly.

* Communicate constantly with the team.

* Work quickly and efficiently.

* Continuously improve your production workflow.

* Research new AI tools and techniques that can improve our creative output.



---



# YOU MUST UNDERSTAND DROPSHIPPING ADVERTISING



We want someone who understands the difference between **traditional e-commerce/brand marketing and direct-response dropshipping.**



We are constantly testing new products.



We are not creating months of content around one established brand identity.



A product can be discovered today, tested through advertising, and potentially scaled rapidly if the numbers show that customers want it.



That means our creative team needs to be extremely adaptable.



You may work on:



* A jacket today

* A men's shirt tomorrow

* A completely different men's product next week



You must be able to quickly understand:



**What is this product?**



**Who would buy it?**



**Why would they want it?**



**What would make them stop scrolling?**



**What angle would make them interested?**



**How can we communicate that visually in 12–15 seconds?**



That is the skill we are looking for.



---



# META ADS EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must have real experience creating *
 and Instagram advertising creatives.**



We are not interested in applicants whose primary experience is:



* YouTube videos

* Entertainment content

* General social media videos

* Wedding videos

* Corporate videos

* Cinematic filmmaking

* Traditional video editing without advertising experience



Your experience must be directly relevant to **performance advertising**.



You should understand how
/Instagram users behave and how creative affects advertising performance.



You should understand concepts such as:



* Scroll-stopping hooks

* Product-focused creatives

* Creative angles

* Audience psychology

* Desire and purchasing intent

* Product benefits

* Problem/solution angles

* Curiosity

* Visual demonstrations

* Creative testing

* Direct-response advertising



---



# YOU NEED TO THINK LIKE A MARKETER



This is one of the most important requirements.



Before creating a video, you should be asking yourself:



**Who am I making this video for?**



**What does this person care about?**



**Why would they want this product?**



**What would make them stop scrolling?**



**What visual would make them interested?**



**What would make them want to see the product?**



**What would make them want to buy it?**



We don't want someone who simply opens an AI tool and starts generating random videos.



We want someone who thinks:



**"I understand the audience. I understand the product. Now how do I create a creative that converts?"**



---



# AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already have professional experience using AI video-generation tools.



You should be comfortable with:



* Image-to-video

* AI video generation

* Product animation

* AI-generated environments

* Scene generation

* Product-focused video generation

* Creative variations

* Video enhancement

* Rapid creative production



You are not required to use any particular platform.



In fact, we prefer someone who is constantly researching and discovering **new and better AI tools.**



If a new AI video platform comes out that can make our production faster or better, we want you to be the person who discovers it and brings it to the team.



---



# EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



You must have:



* **2–4+ years of professional video/advertising experience**

* Real experience creating *
 and Instagram video ads**

* Experience creating direct-response advertising creatives

* Strong understanding of marketing products through video

* Professional AI video-generation experience

* Strong understanding of audience and customer psychology

* Ability to create multiple creative concepts quickly

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong organization skills

* Excellent communication

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to learn new tools quickly



**This is an expert-level position.**



If you are still learning the basics of AI video creation or advertising, please do not apply.



---



# WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO IS:



### FAST



You understand that we test products and creatives at high volume.



You need to consistently produce **20+ usable creatives per day.**



### CREATIVE



You can take one product and develop multiple completely different advertising angles.



### MARKETING-MINDED



You understand that the objective is not simply to make a good-looking video.



The objective is to **sell the product.**



### PROACTIVE



You don't wait for someone to tell you every step.



You research new tools.



You test new techniques.



You bring ideas.



You find ways to make the workflow faster and better.



### ORGANIZED



You can manage multiple products, creative concepts and files without creating confusion.



### COMMUNICATIVE



We work as a team.



Constant communication is important.



If something isn't clear, ask.



If you have an idea, share it.



If you find a better way, tell us.



### AMBITIOUS



We want someone who wants to grow professionally and financially.



We are building a company where people who become more skilled, more productive and more valuable can take on more responsibility and earn more.



### ENERGETIC



We want someone who has energy, initiative and a genuine desire to improve their life and career.



This is a fast-moving company.



We need people who want to move forward with us.



---



# HOW OUR WORKFLOW WORKS



Our process is straightforward.



### STEP 1 — PRODUCT



Our research team identifies products with potential to be scaled.



We provide you with the product.



### STEP 2 — AUDIENCE



We provide information about the audience we are targeting.



You need to understand that audience.



### STEP 3 — CREATIVE STRATEGY



You determine how the product should be presented to that audience.



You develop different hooks, angles and concepts.



### STEP 4 — PRODUCTION



You use AI and your video-production skills to create approximately **20+ creatives per day.**



Each video is approximately **12–15 seconds.**



### STEP 5 — QUALITY CONTROL



You review every creative.



The product must remain accurate.



The video must make sense.



There must be no obvious AI errors.



The creative must be suitable for advertising.



### STEP 6 — SUBMISSION



You organize and submit the completed creatives to our Meta Ads team.



The advertising team then tests the creatives.



---



# PRODUCT ACCURACY IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



AI can create incredible visuals, but it can also distort products.



You must have an extremely strong eye for detail.



You need to catch:



* Incorrect product colors

* Product shape changing

* Missing buttons

* Incorrect details

* Distorted clothing

* Incorrect logos

* Unrealistic movements

* Product changing between scenes

* AI artifacts

* Product becoming unrecognizable



We are selling the actual product.



The creative must represent the actual product accurately.



---



# SALARY & CAREER GROWTH



**Starting Salary: $700 USD/month**



After your first **3 months**, your performance will be reviewed and your salary will be increased based on your performance.



Your growth will depend on:



* Quality

* Speed

* Reliability

* Creative performance

* Initiative

* Communication

* Skill development

* Ability to take on more responsibility

* Contribution to the company's growth



We want people who grow with us.



If you become faster, better, more creative and more valuable to the company, your compensation and responsibilities can increase accordingly.



This is intended to be a **long-term position.**



---



# EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* Reliable MacBook or high-performance computer

* Smartphone

* Fast and reliable internet

* Quiet workspace

* Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM

* Access to the AI/video tools required for your workflow



---



# PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



Do not apply if:



* You have never created AI videos.

* You have no experience creating advertising creatives.

* You have never created
/Instagram video ads.

* Your experience is mainly YouTube.

* Your experience is mainly entertainment content.

* You are only a traditional video editor.

* You are a beginner with AI video tools.

* You don't understand direct-response advertising.

* You don't understand how to market a product through video.

* You cannot consistently produce 20+ creatives per day.

* You prefer spending hours creating one video.

* You need someone to teach you the basics.

* You are not organized.

* You are not proactive.

* You don't communicate well.

* You don't like fast-paced work.

* You are not interested in learning new AI tools.

* You are looking for an easy or low-effort job.

* You don't have a strong desire to grow professionally.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Please use the subject:



**AI VIDEO – [Your Name]**



Please answer **ALL** questions below.



### 1. EXPERIENCE



How many years of professional experience do you have creating video advertising creatives?



How many years have you been using AI video-generation tools?



---



### 2.
 / INSTAGRAM EXPERIENCE



How many years have you been creating video ads specifically for *
 and Instagram?**



Tell us what types of products you have advertised.



---



### 3. AI TOOLS



List all AI video tools you currently use.



Tell us what you use each tool for.



Which AI tool do you believe is currently the fastest for producing direct-response advertising creatives at scale?



Explain why.



---



### 4. PRODUCTION VOLUME



What is the highest number of **usable advertising creatives** you have personally produced in one day?



How long did it take?



Which tools did you use?



---



### 5. MARKETING THINKING



Imagine we give you a men's jacket and tell you that the target audience is men who are interested in upgrading their everyday style.



Give us **5 completely different advertising concepts** you would create.



We don't want five different visual styles.



We want five different **marketing angles.**



Explain briefly:



* Who each concept is targeting

* What the hook would be

* What the customer should feel

* Why you think the concept could convert



---



### 6. WORKFLOW



Imagine we give you **10 new products** and expect approximately **20+ video creatives per day.**



Explain exactly how you would organize your day and workflow to achieve that production volume while maintaining quality.



---



### 7. INITIATIVE



Tell us about a time you discovered a new AI tool, advertising technique or workflow yourself and introduced it into your work.



---



### 8. GROWTH



Where do you see yourself professionally in the next 3–5 years?



What skills do you want to develop?



What would make you want to stay and grow with a company long-term?



---



# IMPORTANT



**Please do not send generic AI-generated answers.**



We are looking for someone with **real professional experience**.



We want someone who understands that:



**Making a video ? making an advertisement.**



And:



**Making a beautiful advertisement ? making a converting advertisement.**



We need someone who understands the complete process:



**Product ? Audience ? Marketing Angle ? Creative ? Attention ? Desire ? Purchase**



If you understand direct-response dropshipping advertising, have real
/Instagram advertising experience, know how to use AI to produce creatives quickly, and have the initiative and ambition to become better every day, **we want to hear from you.**



**Apply only if you are confident that you can perform at a professional level from day one.**

title: Instagram Publishing Assistant (Remote, Contract)
description:
Instagram Publishing Assistant (Remote, Contract)

Company: lowk — anonymous school polls app for US high schoolers Location: Fully remote. Type: Contract, 10 hrs/week to start. Scales with the number of accounts.



The job in one line

You build 10 high school Instagram accounts by finding schools with around a
high school student population and getting the follower count to at least 100.



What you'll do

You'll take 10 lowk school Instagram accounts from zero to a follower base that mirrors the actual student body of each assigned high school, targeting 20% of enrollment followed per account before that account goes public. The core loop is sourcing and following students who have that school named in their bio, and your job is knowing where those students cluster: start with the school's hub accounts — ASB/student government, class-of accounts 
 2028), varsity and JV sports teams, cheer, dance, band, drama, and club accounts — and work systematically through their followers, tagged posts, and follow-backs. From there, mine comment sections: the students commenting on a classmate's post are almost always at the same school, and threading through 5–10 comment sections surfaces entire friend groups faster than follower lists do. Every follow must clear two checks before you hit the button — (1) the bio explicitly names the target high school, and (2) the account belongs to a current high school student, meaning any bio with a college name, a committed-to school, a passed graduation year, or a "c/o" year earlier than this one is skipped, not followed. Equally important is account survival: you are responsible for keeping all 10 accounts unrestricted, which means working inside strict daily follow ceilings, warming new accounts before scaling, spacing actions instead of bursting, and stopping cold on any account that throws an action block rather than pushing through it. You'll log daily follows, follow-back rate, and any restriction events per account in the master sheet, and flag schools where the sourcing pool runs dry before the 20% target.



You will name each account “(school)polls”, either an abbreviated version like “shspolls” or the whole thing like “santiagopolls” depending on availability. You will attach a given bio copy and paste it as the bio of each account, make sure it’s private (super important), and place the school logo on the profile picture.

Core objective: You will keep track of the numbers on a simple spreadsheet. Look for 10 southern California high schools, each with a student population of about
. Get the follower request count to at least 100 on all accounts.

Rules of thumb (non-negotiable):

Warm-up: new account = 80 is the absolute max number of follows you should do on day 1, spread across two different times (40 in the morning, 40 at night for instance), 100 the next day with the same split. Follow at least 5 school based accounts (the school itself, the school’s student council/news, any basketball/volleyball/football teams, etc). Never mass-follow on a fresh account, this will lead to restrictions in following. If this happens, it’ll take even longer to reach the goal.

Blocked = stop: action block means 24–48 hours of zero activity on that account. Do not follow or do anything on that account and move onto the next if restrictions happen. Ensure to tell Cayden, and get back to the account after 2-48 hours have past. Retrying through a block escalates it to a longer or permanent restriction.

No third-party automation tools ever.

No churn: never unfollow to inflate ratio. Follow/unfollow cycling is the single fastest path to a permanent block.



What we're looking for

Required

Experience running multiple social accounts on a fixed daily schedule.

Meticulous. This role is judged almost entirely on whether the right post went out, on the right account, on the right day, with the right school name on it.

Google Sheets.

Reliable internet and a consistent daily working window.

English good enough to read instructions precisely and flag problems clearly. You are not writing content.



Begin your application with "LOWK ROLE" so we know you read this section



Compensation

$35 fixed for the entire project.



How to apply

1, Links to social accounts you've managed, if you can share them.

2, Your timezone and realistic daily working window in US Pacific terms.

3, When can you get started

4, Any questions you may have



We reply to everyone within a day or two.

**Full-Time | Monday – Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM**



---



# ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing **pure dropshipping company** specializing in men's products.



We are constantly testing new products through **Meta Ads —
 and Instagram advertising.**



Every week, our Product Team creates approximately **40 new product pages**.



Once those product pages are approved, they are shared with our
 Ads team.



This is where **you come in.**



You will be assigned approximately **40 product links every week**.



Your responsibility will be to take those product pages and turn them into **fully prepared Meta advertising campaigns.**



You will download the product images, understand the product, research the appropriate audience and interests, create the campaigns according to our systems, and make sure everything is accurate and ready to launch.



This is an important part of our advertising operation.



The quality and accuracy of your campaign setup directly affects the work of our Meta Ads team.



---



# YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY



Your core responsibility is:



## **40 PRODUCTS ? 40 META CAMPAIGNS EVERY WEEK**



For every assigned product, you will:



1. Open the Shopify product page.

2. Study and understand the product.

3. Download the necessary product images.

4. Understand who the product is designed for.

5. Research appropriate
/Meta interests.

6. Select relevant targeting based on the product and our SOPs.

7. Create the Meta campaign.

8. Upload and organize the correct product creatives.

9. Configure the campaign correctly.

10. Check every setting before submission.

11. Make sure the campaign is completely accurate and ready for launch.



You will repeat this process across approximately **40 products every week.**



---



# THIS IS NOT A ROBOTIC JOB

This is extremely important.



You will be creating campaigns for men's products, but our products can be very different from one another.

* Jackets

* Shirts

* Pants

* Shoes

* Accessories

**What type of person would buy this?**



**What interests would make sense?**



**What audience should we test?**



**Is there a better interest I could find?**



We already have SOPs and systems, but we also want someone who can **think.**



If you find a better interest, a better targeting idea or a better way to structure the campaign, we want you to bring that idea to the team.



---



# YOU MUST UNDERSTAND
 / META ADS — CURRENTLY



We are looking for someone with **real, current Meta Ads experience.**



Not someone who ran
 Ads several years ago and assumes everything is still the same.



Meta changes constantly.



The platform, targeting options, campaign structures and best practices evolve.



You need to be actively familiar with **how Meta Ads works today.**



You should already understand:



* Meta Ads Manager

* Meta Business Manager

* Campaigns

* Ad Sets

* Ads

* ABO

* CBO

* Meta Pixel

* Targeting

* Interests

* Audiences

* Budgets

* Placements

*
 Pages

* Ad creatives

* Campaign setup

---



# INTEREST RESEARCH IS IMPORTANT



One of your responsibilities will be finding appropriate **Meta interests and targeting options** for the products you are assigned.



We don't want someone who simply chooses the first interest that comes to mind.



We want someone who is willing to research.



For example, if you receive a men's fashion product, you should be able to think beyond one obvious interest.

* Clothing interests

* Lifestyle interests

* Brands

* Related products

* Hobbies

* Demographics

* Customer behavior

**Product ? Customer ? Interest ? Audience**



---

/Instagram advertising.

Technical knowledge is important.

**Open ? Study ? Download ? Research ? Build ? Check ? Submit**

**Faster + Better + More Accurate**



---



# ZERO-MISTAKE MINDSET

 Page

Our goal is:



## **40 CAMPAIGNS PER WEEK + EXTREMELY HIGH ACCURACY**



---



# EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* Reliable computer.

* **MacBook is strongly preferred.**

*
 account.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Smartphone.

* Quiet workspace suitable for full-time remote work.

* Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM.



---



# SALARY & CAREER GROWTH



## **STARTING SALARY: $600 USD/MONTH**



After your first **3 months**, your performance will be reviewed and **your salary will be increased based on your performance.**



Your future salary increases can be based on:

* Initiative

* Reliability

* Quality of work

* Knowledge

* Improvement

* Contribution to the team

* Ability to take on more responsibility

* Helping others improve

If you become one of the best people in your department, we want your compensation to reflect that.



We believe:



**The better you become ? the more valuable you become ? the more you can earn.**



We are willing to continue increasing compensation for people who consistently work hard, improve, take ownership and contribute to the company's growth.



This is a **full-time, long-term position.**



---

* You have less than 2–3 years of hands-on Meta Ads experience.

* You have never personally created Meta campaigns.

* You don't understand Meta Ads Manager.

 interests and targeting.

---



# HOW TO APPLY



Please use the subject:



**META CAMPAIGN SETUP – [Your Name]**

title: Credit Repair Dispute Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Dispute Specialist to join our growing team.

This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for someone who already understands the credit dispute process and can step into an established workflow without requiring extensive training on the fundamentals.



POSITION DETAILS

* Starting Rate: $5/hour

* Trial Period: 2-week PAID trial

YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH:

* DisputeFox

You should understand how to review a client's credit profile, identify inaccuracies/inconsistencies, determine the appropriate dispute strategy, properly document your work, and move files through the dispute process efficiently.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:

PRODUCTIVITY EXPECTATIONS

* Communication

* Reliability

As you become familiar with our internal processes, an initial benchmark will be approximately 5–8 completed client dispute files during a full working day, depending on file complexity.

Quality and accuracy come first. We are not looking for someone who rushes through client files simply to hit a number.



2-WEEK PAID TRIAL

The purpose of the trial is to make sure we are a good long-term fit and to evaluate your actual work—not just your interview.

“You receive a new client file containing collections, charge-offs, late payments, and inconsistent personal information across the three credit bureaus. Walk us through how you would review the file, determine what should be addressed first, and begin the dispute process.”

“CFPB READY”

at the very top of your application.



Applications that are missing the phrase, resume, video, screenshots, or written response will not be considered.

We're a fast-growing Instagram media brand covering a major U.S. city —

share. We're small, we move fast, and we're looking for one sharp content

creator to own daily production with us.



This is NOT a "design what we hand you" job. You'll help find the stories,

shape the ideas, and build the posts.



SEE OUR PAGE FIRST

Study our brand before you apply: 

Get a feel for our style, tone, and the kind of stories we tell.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design 3–4 Instagram posts per day — carousels and single images — in

  Canva, on-brand and consistent.

- Research the city yourself: local news sites, city/government pages,

  Reddit, Google Maps, and other local Instagram/TikTok accounts. Bring us

  story ideas and angles, don't just wait to be fed them.

  clean typography, fast readability at thumbnail size.

  captions, and idea generation — AI-assisted, always human-checked.

  claim has to be verified before it ships. Accuracy is non-negotiable.

- Keep a consistent posting rhythm and communicate clearly about what's

  done, what's coming, and what you need.



WHO YOU ARE

- Strong Canva skills with a real portfolio of Instagram content

  (carousels especially).

- A researcher at heart — curious, resourceful, and able to learn a city

  and an audience quickly.

- Comfortable using AI tools to work faster, and eager to get better at it.

- Sharp eye for layout, typography, and visual storytelling.

- Excellent written English and reliable, self-directed, consistent.

- Available on a regular weekly schedule (this is close to full-time volume).



BONUS POINTS

- You've designed for a city news, local media, lifestyle, or community brand.

- You have a journalism, media, or communications background.

- You can also do light short-form video editing (Reels).



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is how we filter)

1. Start your message with the word "SKYLINE" so we know you read the

   whole post.

2. Send 2–3 samples of Instagram content you've designed — carousels

   preferred. A live portfolio link is fine.

3. Mini-task (this matters more than your résumé): Look at our page, then

   pick any U.S. city you DON'T live in. In 3–4 sentences, pitch one local

   Instagram post idea you'd make for that city — the topic, the hook

   (first line), and why locals would share it.

4. Tell us which AI tools you use and one example of how you've used them

   in your work.



Applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed. We'll invite the

strongest few to a short paid test project.

title: Studio Growth & Enrollment Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**



We are a growing dance studio with a strong reputation in our community. We believe dance is about far more than movement. We build confidence, leadership, friendships, and lifelong skills through the art of dance. We are looking for someone who genuinely wants to help share that mission and welcome new families into what we are building.





**What This Role Is**



This is a remote, part time position and it is heavily sales focused. The core of this role is outbound outreach to warm leads who have already expressed interest in the studio. These are real people who opted in. Your job is to connect with them, build genuine rapport, and move them toward enrollment through real conversations.



This role is built for someone who can own it. We will give you the structure, the tools, and the direction. After that, we expect you to run with it. The goal is for the right person to own this role fully with little to no hand holding from management. If you need to be micromanaged, this is not the right fit.



This role will evolve. The core is outreach and enrollment, but the scope will grow and shift based on what the studio needs. Some days that means following up with leads. Other days it might mean hunting for new ones, supporting a campaign, creating content, or finding creative ways to generate interest in the community. Whatever drives growth is fair game, and the right candidate will embrace that rather than push back on it.





**What You Will Do**



- Call new leads as fast as possible the moment they come in. The first studio to make contact almost always wins.

- Follow up with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured outreach system

- Manage leads through a full follow up cadence and know where every lead stands at all times

- Log all activity and report daily on outreach and lead responses

- Hunt for new leads through social media, community groups, and online platforms

- Support seasonal campaigns, content creation, and community outreach as needed

- Take on additional tasks as the role grows and studio needs shift





**What We Are Looking For**



- English level C1 or higher, spoken and written. We will assess this.

- Exceptionally strong phone presence. This is the number one filter for this role. You need to sound calm, confident, and in control on every call. Prospects can feel hesitation and uncertainty immediately, and it kills trust before the conversation even starts. If you are smooth, natural, and able to guide a conversation without fumbling, you will thrive here. If phone calls make you nervous or unsure, this is not the right fit.

- Experienced in sales, lead follow up, or relationship based outreach

- Highly organized, dependable, and able to work independently without daily oversight

- Motivated by results and energized by conversations

- Experience with CRM tools or lead tracking systems is a plus

- A background or genuine interest in dance is a bonus, not a requirement





**Schedule**



- Part time, 20 hours per week spread across 7 days

- Availability required during Pacific Standard Time business hours

- Payment is made bi weekly via Wise





**Why This Role Matters**



Every family that reaches out is looking for something real for their child or for themselves. Your job is to make sure they find it here. The faster you respond, the more genuine your follow up, and the better you understand what they need, the more lives this studio gets to impact. This is not a job where you clock in and clock out. It is a role where the right person makes a real difference.



**To Apply**



Send your resume and a short introduction explaining why you would be a great fit. Tell us about a time you followed up consistently with someone and it made a real difference.



Put **Blue Elephant** in the subject line or message title. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist
description:
ATTN: introductory video, your résumé, and your portfolio is required to apply for this position.



About Us:

CURE Advanced Aesthetics Institute is a premier aesthetics and beauty school dedicated to preparing students for successful careers through advanced training, hands-on experience, and industry-recognized certifications. 



Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist



Position Summary



Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute is seeking a motivated, organized, results-driven Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist to help grow enrollment, strengthen prospective student relationships, manage incoming leads, and provide an exceptional customer experience.



This is a sales and conversion-focused position. The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure that prospective students who express interest in our programs receive timely, professional, consistent, and persuasive follow-up designed to move qualified prospects from inquiry to conversation, conversation to application, and application to enrollment.



The ideal candidate must be comfortable with sales, follow-up, telephone conversations, text messaging,
 communication, CRM systems, lead organization, customer service, marketing, and working toward measurable enrollment goals.



We are looking for someone who understands that every inquiry represents a potential student whose life and career may be positively impacted by the right educational opportunity. This individual must be able to build relationships, communicate value, overcome reasonable objections, follow up consistently, and help prospective students confidently determine whether our programs are the right fit for their goals.



?



Primary Responsibilities



Lead Management & Organization



The specialist will be responsible for maintaining an organized and effective lead-management system.



Responsibilities include:



* Receive and manage leads generated through websites, landing pages, Google Ads, social media, events, referrals, telephone calls,
, and other marketing sources.

* Ensure new leads are entered into the appropriate CRM or lead-management system.

* Respond to new inquiries promptly.

* Maintain accurate lead statuses and contact information.

* Categorize leads according to their stage within the enrollment process.

* Maintain detailed notes regarding conversations, interests, concerns, objections, follow-up dates, and next steps.

* Schedule appropriate follow-up activities.

* Prevent qualified leads from becoming lost due to inconsistent communication.

* Maintain an organized daily pipeline of prospects requiring attention.

* Identify older leads that should be re-engaged.

* Keep lead databases accurate, current, and organized.

* Identify high-intent prospects who may be ready to enroll.

* Track prospects from initial inquiry through enrollment.



Every qualified lead should have a clear status, a documented next step, and an appropriate follow-up date.



Sales & Enrollment Conversion



This individual must be comfortable selling educational programs and communicating the value of making an investment in professional education.



Responsibilities include:



* Speak confidently with prospective students regarding available programs.

* Explain program benefits, schedules, learning formats, tuition, payment options, enrollment requirements, and next steps accurately.

* Learn and understand the features, benefits, and ideal student profile for each program.

* Conduct professional sales and admissions conversations by telephone, text,
, video call, and other approved communication methods.

* Ask appropriate questions to understand the prospect’s goals, concerns, career interests, financial considerations, and barriers to enrollment.

* Help prospective students understand which program may best support their goals.

* Clearly communicate the value of the educational opportunity rather than focusing solely on price.

* Professionally address common objections involving tuition, scheduling, distance, fear, uncertainty, timing, and other enrollment concerns.

* Create urgency when appropriate without using misleading or high-pressure sales tactics.

* Ask qualified prospects for the enrollment.

* Provide clear instructions regarding the application and enrollment process.

* Follow up with prospects who begin but do not complete applications or enrollment.

* Re-engage prospective students who previously expressed interest but did not enroll.

* Work toward individual and organizational enrollment goals.



The specialist should understand that successful sales involves relationship building, listening, education, follow-through, confidence, and consistency.



Lead Follow-Up & Nurturing



Consistent follow-up is a major responsibility of this position.



The specialist will:



* Conduct daily follow-up with assigned prospective students.

* Utilize telephone calls, SMS/text messaging,
, and other approved channels.

* Follow established lead-nurturing sequences.

* Personalize communication when appropriate.

* Follow up after tours, consultations, information sessions, events, and applications.

* Reconnect with prospects who stop responding.

* Maintain appropriate communication without becoming unprofessional or excessively aggressive.

* Identify why prospects are not moving forward and communicate useful trends to leadership.

* Ensure scheduled follow-ups are completed on time.

* Create or recommend additional nurturing strategies when current approaches are not producing results.



CRM & Sales Pipeline Management



The specialist must be comfortable working with technology and maintaining accurate information within a CRM or lead-management platform.



Responsibilities may include:



* Maintain prospect records.

* Update lead stages.

* Enter notes after conversations.

* Schedule follow-up activities.

* Track appointments and consultations.

* Monitor application progress.

* Track enrollment outcomes.

* Identify overdue follow-ups.

* Help maintain automated
 and SMS campaigns.

* Identify duplicate or incomplete records.

* Produce or assist with lead and conversion reports.

* Work with platforms such as GoHighLevel, Leadpages, Google Sheets, Kajabi, or other systems adopted by the organization.

* Identify opportunities to improve automation and lead management.



Marketing Support



The specialist will work closely with leadership and other team members to help promote programs and generate qualified inquiries.



Responsibilities include:



* Assist with marketing campaigns for school programs.

* Help develop promotional messaging based on questions and concerns received from prospective students.

* Assist with
 and SMS campaigns.

* Support program launches, enrollment campaigns, open houses, information sessions, webinars, and special events.

* Help identify effective promotional opportunities.

* Review lead quality from different marketing sources and report findings to leadership.

* Communicate recurring questions and objections so marketing messages can be improved.

* Assist with basic social media and digital marketing activities when assigned.

* Work with the team to ensure advertisements, landing pages, sales messaging, and admissions conversations communicate a consistent message.

* Recommend new strategies for generating and converting qualified leads.



Customer Service & Student Experience



Excellent customer service is essential.



The specialist may be one of the first representatives a prospective student encounters and therefore must represent Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute professionally.



Responsibilities include:



* Provide warm, professional, knowledgeable service to prospective and current students.

* Answer general program and enrollment questions accurately.

* Respond to telephone calls,
s, text messages, and inquiries in a timely manner.

* Assist newly enrolled students with understanding their next steps.

* Help direct students to the appropriate staff member when an issue falls outside the specialist’s responsibilities.

* Handle concerns professionally and calmly.

* Document significant concerns or complaints.

* Escalate serious student or customer concerns to leadership appropriately.

* Follow through to ensure questions and concerns are addressed.

* Maintain appropriate professional boundaries with students and prospective students.

* Protect confidential student and business information.



Enrollment Onboarding & Handoff



The responsibility does not end immediately after a prospect says “yes.”



The specialist will help ensure a smooth transition from prospect to enrolled student.



Responsibilities include:



* Confirm required enrollment steps have been completed.

* Ensure necessary information is properly documented.

* Communicate orientation or onboarding information.

* Confirm students understand their immediate next steps.

* Coordinate with appropriate staff regarding newly enrolled students.

* Ensure the student receives a professional handoff from admissions into the educational experience.

* Identify incomplete enrollment requirements and follow up appropriately.



Sales Performance & Accountability



This is a performance-driven position.



The employee must be comfortable having performance evaluated using measurable indicators such as:



* Number of new leads received.

* Lead response time.

* Number of leads contacted.

* Number of meaningful conversations.

* Follow-up completion rate.

* Consultation or appointment bookings.

* Application starts.

* Application completion.

* Enrollment conversions.

* Lead-to-enrollment conversion rate.

* Re-engagement of older leads.

* Customer service responsiveness.

* CRM accuracy.

* Achievement of assigned enrollment goals.



The specialist will be expected to understand their numbers and work with leadership to improve performance when necessary.



Time Management & Productivity



Strong time-management skills are required.



The specialist must:



* Prioritize high-intent leads while maintaining appropriate follow-up with the entire pipeline.

* Complete assigned projects by the assigned due date and due time.

* Manage sales activities, marketing responsibilities, customer service, and administrative assignments simultaneously.

* Maintain an organized daily schedule.

title: Operations Director
description:

We turn our clients' long-form video (podcasts, founders, creators, brands)

s and Slack messages in under 5 minutes during your

Full-time, long-term, fully remote, with direct access to the founders.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist – Google Ads, Meta & App Growth
description:
Send your proposed price and estimated duration for this project.



We are looking for a highly skilled Performance Marketing / Paid Acquisition Specialist to help grow InfoAlanya, a travel and local-services app for people visiting or living in Alanya, Turkey.



This is NOT a social media posting/content role. 



We are looking for someone who is obsessed with:



Finding the cheapest relevant traffic

Lowering Cost Per Install (CPI)

Lowering Cost Per Acquisition / Booking (CPA)

Finding profitable countries, languages and keywords

Tracking actual bookings — not likes or vanity metrics

Testing and scaling what works

About InfoAlanya



InfoAlanya is an app where users can find and book many different things related to Alanya, including:



Airport transfers

Tours and excursions

Restaurants

Beauty clinics/salons

Dental clinics

Local businesses

Activities

Useful tourist information

Pharmacy/emergency information

And other local services



This means we are interested not only in obvious commercial keywords such as:



Alanya tours

Alanya diving

Alanya airport transfer

Dentist Alanya

Alanya hamam



We are also interested in finding very cheap “gateway keywords” such as:



Emergency pharmacy Alanya

Alanya weather

Alanya markets

Alanya beaches

Alanya bus

Things to do in Alanya



A person may enter InfoAlanya for one reason and later purchase another service.



The Main Goal



Your job is to answer one question:



How can we acquire the highest number of valuable InfoAlanya users and bookings for the lowest possible advertising cost?



We want to systematically test:



Google Search

Google App campaigns

Meta /
 / Instagram

Potentially TikTok

Different countries

Different languages

Different keyword groups

Different ad creatives

Different landing/app-store flows



Markets may include:



Denmark

Norway

Sweden

Germany

Poland

UK

Turkey

Netherlands

Other relevant Alanya tourism markets



We do NOT assume Denmark will necessarily be the cheapest market.



We want data to tell us where to spend our money.



Google Ads / Keyword Research



A major part of this role will be identifying opportunities that competitors may be overlooking.



We want someone who can research hundreds of Alanya-related searches and identify combinations of:



Low CPC + relevant user + reasonable search volume + potential lifetime customer value.



You should be comfortable using:



Google Keyword Planner

Google Ads

Search Terms reports

Semrush/Ahrefs or similar tools where useful

Negative keywords

Exact / phrase / broad match strategy

Search-intent analysis

Country/language segmentation



We want keyword research performed separately for different languages and countries.



For example, the same intention should potentially be researched in:



Danish, Norwegian, Swedish, German, Polish, English and Turkish.



Tracking Is Extremely Important



We do not want to optimize only for clicks.



We want to track the complete funnel:



Ad ? App Store / Google Play ? Install ? App Open ? Account Created ? Product Viewed ? Booking Started ? Booking Completed ? Booking Value



You should understand app conversion tracking and be able to work with our mobile/backend developers to define the correct events.



Experience with tools such as Meta SDK, Google Analytics/Firebase, Google Ads conversion tracking and app attribution is highly valuable.



What We Want From You



We do NOT want you simply to launch campaigns and spend our budget.



We want continuous testing.



For every campaign we should be able to see:



Advertising spend

Impressions

Clicks

CPC

App installs

CPI

Accounts created

Bookings

CPA / Cost per Booking

Booking revenue

Estimated profit

ROAS

Country

Language

Keyword/ad responsible for the result



If one market gives us customers for €8 and another gives us customers for €25, we want budget moved toward the €8 market.



If a keyword produces cheap clicks but no valuable users, we stop it.



If an unexpected keyword produces profitable users, we scale it.



IMPORTANT – Please Answer These Questions When Applying



Generic applications will not be considered.



1. Price and Duration



Please state:



Your total project price or hourly rate

Estimated number of hours

Estimated duration to complete the initial setup, research and launch

2. €1,000 Test



Imagine InfoAlanya gives you an initial advertising budget of €1,000.



Explain exactly how you would use the first €1,000.



Which platforms would you test?



Which countries?



How much would you allocate to each?



Why?



3. Keyword Opportunity



Give us at least 10 Alanya-related keyword ideas or keyword groups you would investigate.



We specifically want to know how you would find:



cheap keywords that still bring potentially valuable InfoAlanya users.



Explain how you would determine:



Search volume

CPC

Competition

Intent

Potential customer value

4. Country Testing



How would you determine whether it is cheaper for us to acquire a customer from:



Denmark vs Norway vs Germany vs Poland vs Turkey?



Do not answer only based on CPM.



Explain how you would measure the actual winning market.



5. Cheap Traffic vs Valuable Traffic



Suppose:



Keyword A costs €0.10 per click.



Keyword B costs €1.50 per click.



How would you determine which one is actually better for InfoAlanya?



6. App Tracking



Explain how you would track:



Ad ? Install ? Registration ? Booking ? Booking Value.



What needs to be implemented by you, and what would you need from our developers?



7. Show Real Results



Please show us one real campaign you personally managed.



Tell us:



Platform

Industry

Ad spend

CPC

CPA

Conversion rate

ROAS if applicable

What you changed to improve performance



Screenshots with confidential client information hidden are welcome.



8. Scaling



If you discovered that we could consistently spend €10 to acquire a booking that generates significantly more gross profit than the advertising cost, how would you scale from €500/month to €5,000–€10,000/month without destroying the CPA?



Required Experience



You should have strong experience with several of the following:



Google Ads

Google Search Ads

Google Keyword Planner

Meta Ads

Mobile app advertising

Conversion tracking

Firebase / GA4

Meta Pixel / SDK / Conversions API

Retargeting

Custom audiences

A/B testing

Keyword research

International advertising

Multi-language campaigns

CPA / ROAS optimization



Travel, tourism, marketplace, booking or mobile-app experience is a major advantage.



Working Arrangement



We initially want someone to:



Audit our setup

Create the tracking/measurement plan

title: Etsy Customer Service & Order Specialist
description:
Are you detail-obsessed, a fast learner, and great with customers in writing? Do you want the opportunity to grow alongside a tiny team (me and you) instead of being a number at a big company?



Then keep reading!



Hi! I'm Cindee, the owner of an Etsy print-on-demand shop that's growing fast and needs a right-hand person to grow with it. I'm not looking for someone to just click buttons. I'm looking for a partner who wants to learn a real business from the inside, take ownership of their work, and feel proud of what we build together.



If that sounds like you, please keep reading!





WHAT I OFFER



• Steady, reliable pay. Wise payments every Friday.

• Weekly performance bonus

• Growth opportunity: starts part-time with a clear path to more hours as we grow

• Fully remote: work from anywhere with reliable internet

• Real training with Loom videos, written guides, and hands-on coaching

• A boss who respects your time. I don't micromanage, and I don't expect you online 24/7.

• A mission-driven brand. We create chic, personalized gifts that make life's biggest moments feel as meaningful as they truly are.





ABOUT THE SHOP



I run a growing Etsy print-on-demand shop with 14,000+ sales, 1,500+ five-star reviews, and Etsy Star Seller status.



We focus on personalized gifts for:



• New babies and pregnancy announcements

• Weddings, bridal showers, and bridesmaids

• Grandparents and family gifting

• Sympathy and remembrance

• Birthdays and holidays



I'm actively scaling the business, and I need a great partner to help me get there.





WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



• DETAIL-OBSESSED: you catch typos, spot mistakes, and double-check your work

• GREAT WRITTEN ENGLISH: customers should feel like a warm human wrote to them

• SELF-MOTIVATED AND RESOURCEFUL: you Google before asking me, and you figure things out

• RELIABLE AND CONSISTENT

• KIND AND WARM IN CUSTOMER SERVICE: you actually care about the buyer's experience

• EAGER TO LEARN: willing to watch training videos, take notes, and try new things

• HONEST ABOUT MISTAKES: everyone messes up sometimes. The good ones own it and fix it.





WHAT A DAY-TO-DAY WOULD LOOK LIKE



Your workday would include a mix of:



• CUSTOMER SERVICE. Replying to Etsy messages warmly, professionally, and quickly.

• APPROVING ORDERS FOR PRINT. My system automatically builds the personalization file for each order and uploads it to our print partners. You check that file against what the customer actually asked for, then approve and submit it.

• CATCHING WHAT'S WRONG BEFORE IT PRINTS. Misspelled names, a wrong date, a birth time entered as AM when it should be PM.

• DAILY ORDER TRACKING. Keeping our tracking sheet accurate and current.

• LISTING HELP AND SHOP UPKEEP. Uploading new products, organizing, tagging.



Every order here has a name on it, a date, a detail that matters enormously to the person receiving it. My system builds the files, but it can't tell whether they're right. You'd be the last set of eyes before anything goes to print.



You do NOT need to be a graphic designer, an Etsy expert, or a business expert. I'll teach you everything you need to know. And if you already have e-commerce or Etsy experience, even better. Tell me about it, I'd love to hear it.



What I can't teach is being careful, being kind to customers, and actually reading instructions. That's what I'm hiring for.





REQUIRED SKILLS



• Excellent written English

• Comfortable using a computer with Google Chrome, Google Sheets, and basic web tools

• High level of organization and detail-oriented work ethic

• Reliable high-speed internet and your own computer

• Able to work a split shift 7 days a week: a short session earlier in your day and another in your evening (your evening overlaps our US customers' daytime). About 2-3 hours a day to start.

• Flexible on hours as we head into the busy holiday season





BIG PLUSES (NOT REQUIRED)



• Experience with Etsy (as a seller, buyer, or VA)

• Experience with Printify or other print-on-demand platforms

• Experience with Shopify

• Any Photoshop or Illustrator experience, or a good eye for design

• Experience handling customer service messages

• Comfortable following Loom video training





TOOLS YOU'LL USE



Etsy Shop Manager, Printify, Google Sheets and Docs, Loom, Slack, 1Password, Wise





POSITION AND PAY



• Position: Part-time to start

• Growth path: Additional hours available as you take on more responsibility

• Pay: $5 USD per hour, paid weekly via Wise every Friday, covering the previous Monday through Sunday

• Hours: About 2-3 hours a day, 7 days a week, as a split shift

• Bonus: Weekly, depending on error rate and quality of work

• Contract: Independent contractor (you'll sign an Independent Contractor Agreement and NDA)

• Start date: As soon as we find a great match





HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, you MUST do BOTH of these things. Applications missing either step will be automatically disqualified.



1) REPLY TO THIS JOB POST ON ONLINEJOBS.PH WITH:



• Your resume/CV

• A short intro paragraph about yourself

• Your availability (time zone and working hours, in your own local time)



2) COMPLETE THIS QUICK QUESTIONNAIRE (ABOUT 15 MINUTES):







If you pass Round 1, I'll message you directly with the next step. There are 3 rounds total: this questionnaire, a Google Sheets task, and a longer set of questions about you and your experience. Only the top applicants will be invited to a short video interview at the end.





A NOTE FROM ME

I know applying for jobs is stressful. I'm reading every single application personally, and I appreciate you taking the time to apply. If you're excited about this role, tell me why in your reply! That means a lot to me.



Good luck, and I hope to find someone amazing like you to join me!



— Cindee





REMINDER CHECKLIST BEFORE YOU HIT "APPLY"



• Reply to this job post on OnlineJobs.ph with resume + intro + availability

• Complete the questionnaire linked above

• Read every step carefully. Attention to detail matters. ????



Thanks for reading all the way to the end!

title: Email Marketing Expert
AI-Assisted Technical Operator — Web Apps, Servers, VoIP
description:
Start your application with the word ORBIT so I know you read this post.



I run several US-based businesses on self-managed infrastructure: multiple Ubuntu servers, a set of Node.js/Next.js applications running under PM2 behind Nginx, PostgreSQL/MySQL databases, a custom internal CRM, roughly a dozen websites, and an Asterisk/FreePBX telephony system handling live inbound calls.



I'm looking for ONE person to own technical execution across all of it. This is not a virtual assistant role. I give you a scoped mission and expect a finished result - audited, fixed, tested, documented - without daily supervision. This role eventually carries server and database access, so references will be checked before that is granted.



WHAT A TYPICAL MISSION LOOKS LIKE



"Take this internal web application. Audit it for bugs, fix them, clean up the codebase, make sure it's production-ready for end users. Report what you found and what you changed."

"This application is partially built. Complete the remaining third-party integrations, test end-to-end against the existing spec, confirm it's stable under real usage."

"Audit these websites in Google Search Console. Fix indexing problems, schema errors, Core Web Vitals, and crawl issues. Show me before and after."

"Inbound calls are dropping on our phone system. Trace the full call path - dialplan, database state, backend workers, logs - find the root cause and fix it."

"Build an automation that moves data between two of our systems on a schedule, with retries, logging, and failure alerts."



You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) as your primary leverage. That is expected and encouraged. But you must be senior enough to know when the AI is wrong - you review its output, you understand the code it produces, and you never push anything to production you can't explain line by line.



TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT



Node.js, Next.js, TypeScript, React

PostgreSQL / MySQL, Redis

Ubuntu, Nginx, PM2, systemd, Git

Asterisk / FreePBX - dialplan, SIP trunks, DID management, call routing

REST APIs, webhooks, third-party integrations, automation workflows

Google Search Console, technical SEO



REQUIRED



4+ years building and maintaining production web applications

Daily hands-on use of AI coding agents against real codebases, not occasional ChatGPT questions

Comfortable in a Linux terminal on servers you did not set up yourself

Can read an unfamiliar codebase and locate the bug without hand-holding

Traces problems end-to-end through logs, database state, and configuration before guessing

You finish what you start. You test before calling it done. You document what you changed.

Strong written English - you will be sending me findings and reports



STRONG PLUS



Asterisk, FreePBX, or any SIP/VoIP experience

n8n, Make, or similar automation platforms

Multi-tenant SaaS architecture

Technical SEO across many sites

Experience being the only technical person in an organization



NOT A FIT IF



You need daily supervision or task-by-task instruction

Your experience is only on managed platforms (Vercel, Netlify, WordPress hosting)

You have never administered a Linux server or touched telephony

Your approach is pasting code into an AI and forwarding whatever comes back



PROCESS



Short intro call, then a PAID technical assessment (4-6 hours of real work on an isolated staging environment). Long-term, full-time position with room to grow into owning the full stack. You will need 3-4 hours of daily overlap with US Central time.



TO APPLY - ANSWER THESE FOUR QUESTIONS



Applications without answers will not be reviewed.



Q1. Describe a production bug you found in code you did not write. How did you trace it to root cause?



Q2. Which AI coding tool do you use, on what kind of work, and give me one specific example where it was confidently wrong and you caught it.



Q3. Have you worked with Asterisk, FreePBX, or any VoIP system? What specifically did you do?



Q4. A Node.js app on Ubuntu is returning 502 errors. Walk me through your first 10 minutes.

title: Podcast Video Editor and Short-Form Content Editor
description:
Podcast Video Editor and Short-Form Content Editor



Fieldhouse Studios is a professional podcast and content production studio that helps business owners, entrepreneurs and creators produce high-quality video podcasts and social media content.



Our monthly clients receive up to 15 hours of studio filming, professional production, lighting and camera support. Each client package includes six full podcast episodes, 24 social media shorts and custom episode thumbnails.



We are looking for a dependable and creative video editor who can turn professionally filmed podcast sessions into polished long-form episodes and engaging short-form content.



Responsibilities:



You will be responsible for editing content from professionally recorded podcast sessions into:



* Six 45 to 90-minute video podcast episodes per month

* Four short-form videos from each episode

* 24 total short-form videos per month

* Six podcast thumbnails per month

* Audio-only podcast files when requested



You may also be asked to:



* Sync footage from multiple cameras and separate audio sources

* Select the best camera angles throughout each episode

* Remove mistakes, long pauses, repeated statements and unnecessary sections

* Balance and clean audio for clear, consistent sound

* Perform basic color correction and camera matching

* Add branded introductions, outros, lower thirds, logos and transitions

* Add captions and attention-grabbing on-screen text to short-form videos

* Identify strong moments, hooks and valuable insights for social media clips

* Add music, graphics and sound effects when appropriate

* Format content for TikTok,
, Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube

* Organize project files and exports using our naming and folder system

* Complete reasonable revisions based on internal or client feedback



Content Specifications



Full Podcast Episodes



* Approximately 45 to 90 minutes each

* Multi-camera video editing

* Clean, professional audio

* 16:9 horizontal format

* Exported for YouTube and podcast distribution

* Consistent branding and visual style



Short-Form Videos



* Four clips per podcast episode

* Generally 30 to 90 seconds each

* 9:16 vertical format

* Strong opening hook

* Accurate burned-in captions

* Engaging pacing and camera changes

* Platform-ready exports for TikTok,
 Reels, Instagram Reels, LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts



Thumbnails



* One thumbnail per podcast episode

* Clear, professional and consistent with client branding

* Designed to attract attention without using misleading clickbait

* Properly formatted for YouTube



Required Qualifications



* Proven experience editing video podcasts, interviews or multi-camera content

* Strong short-form editing skills

* Ability to identify compelling hooks and social media moments

* Experience syncing multiple cameras and external audio

* Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling and viewer retention

* Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or another professional editing platform

* Experience creating accurate animated captions

* Basic graphic design and thumbnail creation skills

* Reliable internet access and the ability to download and upload large video files

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent written communication

* Ability to follow brand guidelines and editing instructions

* Dependable availability and consistent turnaround times



Preferred Qualifications



* Experience editing business, educational or interview-style podcasts

* Experience with Adobe After Effects, Photoshop or Canva

* Understanding of YouTube retention and short-form content performance

* Familiarity with 
, Google Drive, Dropbox or similar file-sharing platforms

* Ability to improve content through creative editing without making it feel overproduced



Turnaround Expectations



Completed first drafts should generally be delivered within 5 business days after receiving the footage and creative instructions.



The ideal candidate can manage recurring monthly deadlines, communicate early if a delay is expected and complete revisions promptly.



What We Provide:



* Professionally recorded multi-camera footage

* Separate audio files

* Brand guidelines and client assets

* Editing examples or style references

* Clear episode and deliverable expectations

* Organized feedback

* Consistent monthly work for the right editor



What We Are Looking For



We want someone who is more than a basic video cutter. The right editor understands how to make long conversations feel polished, how to find strong short-form moments and how to create content that represents our clients professionally.



You should be organized, responsive and comfortable working independently. Consistency, communication and attention to detail are extremely important.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A brief introduction and overview of your editing experience

2. Links to two or three long-form podcast or interview videos you edited

3. Links to three or more short-form videos you edited

4. One or two examples of thumbnails you created

5. The editing software you use

6. Your typical turnaround time for a 45 to 90-minute multi-camera podcast

7. Your monthly rate for six podcast episodes, 24 short-form videos and six thumbnails

8. Your current availability and time zone

9. A description of your internet speed and computer setup

10. The phrase “Fieldhouse Editor” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire posting



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid editing test using a sample piece of podcast footage.



We are looking for a long-term editing partner who can grow with Fieldhouse Studios and consistently deliver professional content for our clients.

title: Client Operations Coordinator - AI SaaS (Part-Time)
description:
ABOUT SELLBYCHAT



SellByChat is an early-stage AI SaaS company helping businesses turn Instagram DMs into qualified conversations and booked calls. We need a calm, highly organised Client Operations Coordinator who can protect the client experience and give the founder back focused time.



THIS IS NOT A GENERIC VA ROLE.



Your mission: every active client is checked, every problem has evidence and a next action, every client waiting for an update receives one, and the founder sees only decisions that require founder authority.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Check every active client during your assigned coverage window

- Monitor connection health, reply behaviour, human handoffs and booking tracking

- Triage client questions and operational issues

- Gather screenshots, timestamps, examples and missing access before escalating

- Write short, accurate client updates using approved templates

- Maintain the Client Health sheet and Issue Log

- Chase outstanding client inputs and overdue actions

- Turn repeated questions into clear SOPs

- Escalate urgent or high-impact problems immediately



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



- Guess technical root causes

- Promise features or deadlines without approval

- Issue credits or change commercial terms

- Pause or relaunch a client system without founder approval

- Hide mistakes or make unsupported claims



SUCCESS AFTER 14 DAYS



- 100% of assigned client checks completed

- Every urgent condition escalated correctly

- At least 80% of routine requests handled without founder involvement

- Zero unsupported promises

- Repeated questions converted into procedures

- Founder support time clearly trending down



YOU MUST HAVE



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong judgement and common sense

- Customer support, client operations or SaaS support experience

- Clear, concise writing without fluff

- Confidence asking for missing evidence before acting

- Reliable internet plus a backup plan

- Ability to work independently and follow an escalation system

- Comfort with Google Sheets, chat tools and learning AI software



HOURS AND PAY



- Part-time: 12-15 hours per week

- Consistent Monday-Friday coverage window, agreed before the trial

- USD $8-$10 per hour, based on demonstrated skill and judgement

- First engagement is a 14-day paid trial

- Strong performance can become an ongoing role



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the exact words: CLEAR BEFORE FAST.



Then answer all four questions:



1. A client says: "The bot is broken and I think we are losing leads. Fix it ASAP." Write your exact first reply and list the first five facts you would collect.

2. Describe one work mistake you personally made. How did you communicate it, fix it and prevent it happening again?

3. What consistent Monday-Friday working hours can you commit to, in Philippine Time?

4. What is your internet setup and backup plan?



Generic applications, skipped questions and obviously copied answers will not progress. Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical test using anonymised client situations.

title: Senior Back End Developer
description:
About the role



You will take primary ownership of third-party integrations and supporting back-end work on a large-scale association web platform. This is a focused, well-scoped role: you will not be spread across CRM architecture or business rules discovery — that work is handled separately. Your lane is the integration layer and the back-end services that support it.



You will work alongside an existing development team and report into our technical lead. The platform is being built on a modern .NET stack with a clean architecture approach, and you will be expected to come up to speed quickly and deliver to a high standard independently.





What you will do

- Design and build third-party integrations, primarily Stripe (payments) and DocuSign (document workflows), via REST APIs and webhooks

- Develop and maintain back-end services and APIs (REST and GraphQL) within a Clean Architecture structure

- Write robust, well-tested code with strong unit test coverage

- Work within an Azure-hosted environment using Azure App Service

- Collaborate with the team on authentication and identity management via Microsoft Entra ID

- Coordinate with the broader development team to ensure integration work aligns with the platform's core data and business logic





What you will bring

- Solid hands-on experience with C# / .NET, particularly ASP.NET Core

- Strong understanding and practical application of Clean Architecture (Domain / Application / Infrastructure / API layering)

- Experience with Entity Framework Core and PostgreSQL

- Proven experience integrating third-party REST APIs and webhooks, specifically platforms such as Stripe and DocuSign

- Familiarity with GraphQL APIs

- A strong unit testing discipline — you write tests as a matter of course, not as an afterthought

- Working knowledge of Azure App Service

- Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID for authentication and identity management

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of your scope without needing heavy direction





Engagement

- Type: Fixed-term

- Start: ASAP

- Location: Remote-friendly





To apply



Send your CV and a brief note on relevant experience to 
 without back-end integration experience (specifically REST APIs, webhooks, and payment/document platforms) will not be considered.
