title: Client Experience & Business Development Specialist.
description:
We are seeking a professional **Client Experience & Business Development Specialist** to become one of the first points of contact between Falcon Scope Global and prospective clients.



This is **not a traditional high-pressure sales position**.



Your responsibility is to create relationships.



You will introduce our company to potential clients, learn about their needs, provide excellent customer service, maintain professional follow-up, identify business opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our Sales Closer.



**You open the relationship.

Our Sales Closer closes the contract.

Our operations team delivers the service.**



---



# Your Core Responsibilities



### Client Experience



Provide an exceptional experience during every interaction with prospective and existing clients.



You will:



* Answer and respond to business inquiries

* Communicate professionally by phone and

* Assist clients with general questions

* Follow up after conversations and meetings

* Maintain strong client relationships

* Help ensure clients receive timely responses

* Escalate important issues to management

* Maintain professional communication throughout the customer journey



### Business Development



You will proactively introduce Falcon Scope Global to organizations that may need our services.



This includes:



* Researching prospective companies

* Identifying decision-makers

* Making professional B2B outbound calls

* Sending personalized introduction
s

* Following up with prospects

* Learning about upcoming events and staffing needs

* Identifying potential contract opportunities

* Scheduling qualified appointments

* Re-engaging previous prospects

* Building a long-term business pipeline



---



# Who You'll Contact



You may communicate with:



* Event Operations Directors

* Convention Services Managers

* Hotel Operations Managers

* Procurement Departments

* Vendor Relations Departments

* Event Producers

* Venue Managers

* Hospitality Executives

* General Managers

* Operations Directors

* Corporate Event Managers



Our target organizations include hotels, resorts, convention companies, trade show organizations, event production companies, venues, stadiums, arenas, corporate event organizations, hospitality companies, and other businesses requiring professional event support.



---



# The Sales Process



### STEP 1 — Research



Identify companies that could benefit from Falcon Scope Global.



### STEP 2 — Connect



Reach the appropriate decision-maker through professional calls and
s.



### STEP 3 — Discover



Learn about their company, upcoming events, workforce challenges, and operational needs.



### STEP 4 — Qualify



Determine whether there is a genuine opportunity for Falcon Scope Global to help.



### STEP 5 — Schedule



Book a qualified meeting with our Sales Closer.



### STEP 6 — Support



Provide the closer with accurate notes about the prospect and their needs.



### STEP 7 — Follow Up



Continue nurturing the relationship when appropriate.



---



# What You Will NOT Be Expected To Do



You are not responsible for negotiating major contracts or aggressively pushing customers to purchase services.



Our dedicated **Sales Closer** handles:



* Detailed sales presentations

* Pricing discussions

* Proposals

* Negotiations

* Contract discussions

* Closing the business



Your responsibility is to create **high-quality business opportunities**.



---



# What We Expect



We are looking for someone who is:



* Professional

* Confident

* Friendly

* Reliable

* Organized

* Coachable

* Persistent without being aggressive

* Excellent at listening

* Comfortable speaking with business executives

* Able to communicate clearly in English

* Strong in written English

* Comfortable making outbound calls

* Comfortable using CRM software

* Detail-oriented with follow-up



Previous experience in **customer service, customer experience, B2B sales, lead generation, appointment setting, hospitality, or business development** is strongly preferred.



---



# How Performance Is Measured



We value **quality conversations and real opportunities**, not meaningless activity.



Performance will be evaluated using:



* Qualified decision-makers reached

* Quality business conversations

* Qualified opportunities generated

* Meetings scheduled

* Meeting attendance rate

* Follow-up completion

* CRM accuracy

* Client communication quality

* Opportunities that progress to proposals

* Opportunities that become Falcon Scope Global clients



---



# Compensation



### Base Compensation + Performance Incentives



Team members may earn additional incentives for:



* Qualified meetings

* Meetings successfully completed

* Opportunities that progress through the sales pipeline

* New clients generated from their outreach

* Outstanding customer experience

* Exceptional monthly performance



Full compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.



---



# Career Growth



We want people who can grow with Falcon Scope Global.



High-performing team members may advance into:



**Senior Client Experience Specialist**



?



**Business Development Specialist**



?



**Account Manager**



?



**Team Leader**



?



**Client Experience / Business Development Manager**



---



# Our Standard



We don't want robotic cold calls.



We don't want spam.



We don't want employees simply reading scripts.



We want professionals who can **communicate, listen, build trust, identify opportunities, and create relationships. **



Every phone call,
, and conversation represents Falcon Scope Global.



### Our Philosophy



**Don't chase people. Build relationships. **



**Don't just book appointments. Create opportunities. **



**Don't treat businesses like numbers. Treat them like future partners.**



---



# FALCON SCOPE GLOBAL LLC



### Convention Services • Event Operations • Workforce Solutions



**Professional People. Exceptional Experiences. Reliable Operations. **



If you're ready to grow with an ambitious company and help build meaningful business relationships, we want to hear from you.

title: Premium Online Fitness Coach & Training Partner
description:
Long-term role | Remote | Excellent English essential | Competitive pay for the right person



I’m looking for an exceptional online fitness coach and training partner to work with me on a long-term basis.



This is not a basic “send me a workout plan once a week” coaching role.



I’m looking for someone who genuinely loves training, nutrition and self-improvement — someone who can coach me, challenge me, keep me accountable and share the journey alongside me.



I’m willing to pay properly for the right person. I would rather hire one outstanding person than choose the cheapest applicant.



What I’m looking for



You should be someone who:



* Trains seriously yourself and lives the lifestyle you coach

* Has excellent knowledge of strength training, fitness, nutrition and body composition

* Can design and adapt effective training programmes

* Understands accountability and behaviour change, not just exercise selection

* Is confident enough to challenge me when my effort or discipline drops

* Has excellent written and spoken English

* Is naturally engaging, positive and good fun to work with

* Can have a laugh and some banter while still maintaining high standards

* Is proactive rather than waiting for me to message first

* Is extremely reliable and consistent

* Is comfortable communicating regularly through photos, videos, messages and video calls



The Training Partner Element



The unusual part of this role is that I don’t just want somebody coaching from the sidelines.



I want you to share your own fitness journey too.



That could include:



* Your workouts

* Training photos/videos

* Meals and nutrition

* Weekly weight/check-in

* Progress photos

* Your own goals and challenges



I’ll be doing the same.



The idea is to create genuine two-way accountability.



Some days you’ll be pushing me. Other days we might both be comparing sessions, sharing meals, discussing progress or challenging each other to perform better.



I want it to feel more like having a high-level remote training partner who also happens to be an excellent coach.



What you’ll be responsible for



Coaching



* Build and manage my training programme

* Review performance and progress

* Help manage nutrition and calorie/macronutrient targets

* Adjust training based on results, recovery and lifestyle

* Help me improve body composition, fitness and strength

* Keep me focused on my longer-term objectives



Daily Accountability



We will communicate most days.



This could include:



* Workout completed messages

* Training photos/videos

* Exercise technique videos

* Meal photos

* Steps/activity

* Nutrition

* General accountability

* Calling each other out when standards slip



I want interaction, not automated messages or somebody checking in once every few days.



Weekly Review



We will have a weekly video call to review:



* Training

* Weight

* Progress pictures

* Nutrition

* Performance

* What went well

* What needs improving

* Targets for the following week



Who this role will suit



You may already be a:



* Personal Trainer

* Online Fitness Coach

* Strength & Conditioning Coach

* Sports Coach

* Serious fitness enthusiast with strong coaching knowledge



Qualifications are useful, but they are not enough on their own.



Personality, knowledge, communication, consistency and whether we work well together are more important to me.



What I DON’T want



Please don’t apply if you’re looking to:



* Send a generic PDF programme and disappear

* Copy workouts from ChatGPT or another coaching platform

* Send repetitive motivational messages

* Check in once per week and call it coaching

* Take on another client that you’ll barely have time to speak to

* Tell me what you think I want to hear



I want someone who becomes personally invested in getting results.



Commitment



This is intended to be a long-term position, not a short project.



For the right person, I want to build a strong working relationship where you understand my training, lifestyle, habits, strengths and weaknesses extremely well.



There will be regular communication, but I am not expecting someone to be available 24/7.



Quality and consistency matter far more than sitting online for a certain number of hours.



Compensation



Competitive and negotiable depending on experience and quality.



I am prepared to pay more for somebody exceptional.



Please don’t discount yourself just because this role is being advertised on OnlineJobs.ph.



The successful applicant may initially complete a paid trial period so we can both make sure the partnership works.



How to Apply



I’m expecting a lot of applications, so please put TRAINING PARTNER at the top of your application.



Then answer these questions:



1. Tell me about your own training and fitness journey.

2. What are you currently training for?

3. What does your normal week’s training look like?

4. What experience do you have coaching other people?

5. How would you approach coaching someone who is highly motivated for two weeks and then starts slipping?

6. What would daily accountability with you actually look like?

7. Are you comfortable sharing your own workouts, meals, weight and progress with me?

8. Send me a short 60–90 second video introducing yourself and explaining why you’d be a great fit.



Don’t send me a generic cover letter.



I want to understand your personality, your training philosophy and what it would actually be like having you as my coach and training partner.



I’m looking for someone exceptional — and I’m happy to pay for exceptional.

title: Shopify Store Builder & E-Commerce Web Designer

We’re looking for a skilled **Shopify Store Builder & E-Commerce Web Designer** to help us build, improve, and launch high-quality Shopify stores and landing pages.



We are looking for someone who can take an idea, reference, or general direction and turn it into a **professional, polished, and conversion-focused Shopify experience**. You should have a strong eye for design, understand e-commerce best practices, and be comfortable handling both the visual and technical sides of building a Shopify store.



What You’ll Be Doing



* Build complete **Shopify stores from the ground up**

* Design and build **high-converting product pages**

* Create professional and engaging **homepages**

* Build custom **landing pages and sales pages**

* Customize Shopify themes to match our branding and creative direction

* Optimize layouts for **desktop and mobile**

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot **Shopify apps**

* Set up navigation, collections, products, variants, menus, and other store elements

* Make light customizations using **HTML, CSS, Liquid, and/or JavaScript** when necessary

* Improve existing Shopify pages and stores

* Ensure stores are visually consistent, easy to navigate, and built with **conversion rate optimization (CRO)** in mind

* Test pages and functionality before launch

* Work independently and communicate clearly about progress, questions, and recommendations



## What We’re Looking For



You should have:



* **At least 1 year of hands-on Shopify experience**

* Experience building Shopify stores for **e-commerce brands**

* A strong portfolio of Shopify stores, landing pages, product pages, or similar projects

* Strong understanding of modern **e-commerce web design**

* Experience designing pages that are not only attractive but also focused on **conversions and sales**

* Strong understanding of mobile-responsive design

* Experience installing and configuring Shopify apps

* Familiarity with Shopify themes and theme customization

* Basic knowledge of **HTML, CSS, Shopify Liquid, and JavaScript**

* Ability to recreate or take inspiration from reference websites and designs

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to work independently without needing step-by-step instructions for every task

* Good communication skills and ability to meet deadlines



 Bonus Skills



These are not required but would be a major plus:



* Experience with page builders such as **Replo, PageFly, GemPages, Shogun, or similar tools**

* Experience with CRO and A/B testing

* Understanding of direct-response e-commerce

* Experience designing stores for products advertised through Meta, TikTok, Google, or other paid traffic channels

* Experience with upsells, bundles, subscriptions, reviews,
/SMS integrations, and other e-commerce applications

* Graphic design experience using Figma, Photoshop, Canva, or similar tools

* Experience improving Shopify site speed and performance



## The Type of Person We Want



We’re not looking for someone who simply installs a Shopify theme and changes the colors.



We want someone who can be given a product, brand direction, competitor examples, or an idea and **figure out how to turn it into a great Shopify store or page**.



You should be creative, resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable making recommendations when you see opportunities to improve the design or customer experience.



You should understand that an e-commerce website needs to **look great while also helping customers understand the product, trust the brand, and ultimately make a purchase.**



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your Shopify experience

2. How many years you have worked with Shopify

3. **3–5 examples of Shopify stores, product pages, or landing pages you personally built**

4. Which Shopify page builders and themes you have experience with, must put the word heat as the first word in your reply subject line

5. Your experience with HTML, CSS, Liquid, and JavaScript

6. Your availability and preferred working hours

7. Your expected hourly rate or monthly rate



**Important:** Please only send examples of work that you personally worked on. Be prepared to explain specifically what you were responsible for on each project.



We’re looking for someone we can work with consistently, not just for a single website project. There will be ongoing opportunities to build new stores, create landing pages, improve existing pages, and help us continuously improve our e-commerce websites.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Us

We're a dog training company with over half a million followers across our platforms and more than 50 million views in the past month alone. Our content teaches real dog owners how to solve real problems: leash pulling, jumping, puppy biting, and everything in between. We have systems that work, and we're looking for someone to help us scale them.



You can find us on 
 
 
 



The Role

Every week you'll receive raw training footage, usually 20 to 40 minutes per session. Your job is to turn that into tight, engaging 2 to 3 minute videos for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and
.



That means finding the story inside long footage, cutting everything that doesn't serve the viewer, and opening with a hook strong enough to stop the scroll. We have established editing conventions and a reference guide, and we'll train you on them. What we need from you is the skill to execute and the drive to get better every week.



What You'll Do

- Edit weekly raw footage into 2 to 3 minute short form videos

- Choosing the right hook from the footage you are provided with

title: CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER (CFO)
description:
We are looking for an exceptional Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to build, manage and optimize the financial and operational backbone of our international luxury fashion group.



This is far more than an accounting position.



You will oversee finance, accounting, cash flow, operational control, international logistics, supplier payments, customer collections and management reporting across multiple companies operating in different parts of the world.



We are looking for someone who combines the precision of a CFO with the mindset of an entrepreneur and the operational discipline of a COO.

Our business operates across Europe, the United States and Asia, serving both retail and wholesale customers.



Our ambition is to become one of the world’s leading luxury fashion houses.





Your Mission



You will build complete financial transparency throughout the company.



Every euro, every dollar, every invoice, every shipment and every payment must be visible, controlled and predictable.



You will become one of the founder’s closest strategic partners.

* Lead the complete financial organisation.

* Control budgets and profitability.

* Prepare monthly management reports.

* Build KPI dashboards for management.

* Improve financial processes continuously.

* Consolidate international reporting.

* Monitor customer collections.

* Control supplier payments.

* Manage banking relationships.

* Optimise cash management internationally.

Operations & Supply Chain



* Monitor international goods flows.

* Control inventory movements.

* Coordinate logistics with suppliers, warehouses and freight partners.

* Ensure operational reporting is always accurate.

* Work closely with operations and logistics teams.



Business Systems



* Improve ERP processes.

* Connect financial data with operational reporting.

* Ensure accurate dashboards and real-time KPIs.

* Help automate reporting wherever possible.





Required Experience



* International Finance

* Corporate Accounting

* Treasury

* Cash Flow Management

* Budgeting & Forecasting

* Financial Analysis

* International Tax

* VAT

* Supply Chain Finance

* Inventory Control

* Operations Management

* ERP Systems

* Xero (strong advantage)

* Shopify (advantage)

* Excel / Google Sheets

* Power BI or similar reporting tools





Leadership



You will directly manage international finance operations and coordinate accounting teams across multiple countries.



You enjoy creating structure, improving systems and bringing complete financial control to fast-growing international businesses.





Who You Are



You are analytical.



You are structured.



You are highly organised.



You see risks before they become problems.



You enjoy solving operational challenges.



You understand both finance and business.

You think internationally.



You communicate clearly.



You take ownership.



Most importantly…

You improve businesses.

* Direct collaboration with the founder.

* International exposure across Europe, the USA and Asia.

* The opportunity to build world-class financial systems from the ground up.

* Significant autonomy and responsibility.

* Long-term growth opportunities as the company expands internationally.





Apply via WhatsApp

* Countries and legal entities you have managed

B2B Sales Development Representative / Cold Caller – U.S. Market



Hi, we’re currently building our sales team and looking for someone with solid B2B cold-calling experience who is friendly, confident, professional, and comfortable speaking with businesses in the United States.



We sell a branded product to property management companies, hotels, retirement communities, and other commercial properties throughout the U.S.



We already have a large database of leads, so you will not need to find your own prospects.



Your main job will be to make outbound calls, get through the gatekeeper, reach the right decision-maker, briefly explain why we are calling, create interest in the product, and get the best contact information so we can send them more details.



In most cases, we will already have the company name, phone number, and business address. Your job will be to confirm the correct decision-maker, get their name and
 address, and confirm the business mailing address when needed.



If a prospect shows interest, we may send them information by both
 and regular mail, so accuracy is important.



You will also enter simple notes and contact information into GoHighLevel after each call.



This is not really a hard-closing position.



We are mainly looking for someone who is very good on the phone, knows how to get past gatekeepers, can reach the right person without sounding pushy, and can create enough interest for the prospect to want more information.



Our video,
, and website will do much of the selling after that.



We are looking for someone with very good spoken English, a clear and confident phone voice, B2B cold-calling or outbound sales experience, and strong communication skills.



Experience with U.S. businesses is highly preferred.



You should be comfortable making a high number of quality calls each day while still sounding natural and professional.



Experience with appointment setting, SDR work, outbound sales, or closing is a plus.



You should also have reliable internet, a quiet place to work, and be comfortable using GoHighLevel. We will provide training on our process and how we want the leads handled.



The main work schedule will be Monday through Friday, approximately 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.



Since we call businesses throughout the U.S., some leads may be grouped by time zone so we are calling companies during normal business hours in their local area.



Starting pay is $8 USD per hour, paid weekly.



Performance bonuses may also be available.



If you have a strong track record in B2B cold calling and are exceptionally good on the phone, we may be able to offer a higher rate.



We pay through Wise, Remitly, or Venmo.



Full-time and part-time candidates may be considered.



When applying, please send us a short summary of your B2B sales and cold-calling experience, your current hourly rate, whether you are looking for full-time or part-time work, and your availability during U.S. business hours.



Please also send a short voice recording introducing yourself. It does not need to be formal. We mainly want to hear your natural speaking voice, tone, confidence, and English communication.



If you have a sample of a past cold call or sales call that you are allowed to share, please feel free to send that as well.



We have plenty of leads and are looking to build a strong, long-term sales team.



If you are confident on the phone, enjoy speaking with businesses, and know how to get to the right person in a friendly and professional way, we would be happy to hear from you.



Best regards,



Eric B

title: Creative Video Editor & Social Media Content Producer
description:
I’m building Lost Coast Naturals, a minimalist skincare brand focused on simple, functional products, and I’m looking for someone to work with me on short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.



I’ve been documenting the process of building the brand, so I have a growing library of product footage and photography, along with ideas for videos. What I need help with is consistently turning those ideas into complete pieces of content.



A big part of the role is video editing, but I’m hoping to find someone who can also help shape an idea before we get to the edit. Sometimes I’ll have a clear concept and the footage ready to go. Other times I may need help figuring out the hook, a simple script, how the video should flow, or what additional shots would make it work.



What I’d like help with:



* Editing short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

* Turning rough ideas into clear video concepts

* Helping with hooks, scripts, and video structure

* Giving some direction on how or where to shoot something when needed

* Adding music, text, sound, transitions, and other editing elements where they make sense

* Developing new content ideas and repeatable formats over time



The brand and style:



Lost Coast Naturals is a founder-led brand, so part of the content will tell the story behind the business and bring me into it. But the products and formulas are the hero.



Visually, the brand is minimalist, functional, and somewhat technical, with a clean and restrained aesthetic that intentionally feels different from a typical skincare or lifestyle brand.



More than anything, I’m looking for someone with good taste and creativity. I like collaborating with people who are confident in their skills, have their own point of view, and are comfortable suggesting a different direction when they think it will make the work better.



I want someone who understands what makes social content engaging, but also knows when keeping something simple is the better creative choice.



You can check out 
 to get a feel for the products, photography, and overall brand identity. If you understand the concept and feel like it’s something you can connect with, we’ll probably work well together.



The role:



I’m thinking around 10 to 15 hours per week to start, with the possibility of growing from there.



I’d like to eventually get into a rhythm of creating around 3 to 4 strong pieces of short-form content per week, but I care more about making good content than posting something just to hit a number.

,

title: Front Desk Care Navigator
description:
About Isaac Health

Isaac Health is a fast-growing Series A-stage startup specializing in dementia and brain health care

through our multidisciplinary virtual memory clinic. Operating across all 50 states, we partner

with payers nationwide to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care.

As we expand, we are seeking a dedicated, empathetic, and detail-oriented Virtual Front Desk

Receptionist / Patient Services Representative (PSR) to join our team. You will be the first voice

our patients and caregivers hear, shaping their entire experience with Isaac Health.



Role Overview

This role acts as the virtual front desk of our clinic. You will answer phones, assist with

scheduling appointments, process referrals and orders, and respond to basic patient

questions. You’ll primarily support patients not enrolled in ongoing care navigation

services, while also identifying those who may benefit from more comprehensive

support. This role is non-clinical and focused on patient services, reception, and

administrative excellence.

The position blends administrative precision with patient-facing empathy. The ideal

candidate can communicate clearly and warmly with older adults, resolve issues

efficiently, and uphold the highest service standards to ensure a positive patient

experience.



Key Responsibilities

Patient Intake & Front Desk Support

- Answer calls promptly and professionally, serving as the first point of contact for

patients and families.

- Guide patients through the intake process, ensuring all required forms are

complete.

- Assist with scheduling appointments and routing patients to the right team

(outreach/intake, technical support, care navigation, healthcare providers, billing

and eligibility).



Referrals, Records & Orders

- Process referrals and medical orders accurately and on time.

- Coordinate with the internal team to request and send medical records to external

facilities in compliance with HIPAA standards.

Patient Experience & Service Recovery

- Deliver a “white glove” experience by resolving concerns quickly and

empathetically.

- Communicate with warmth, patience, and clarity — especially with older adults and

caregivers who may have cognitive or behavioral challenges.

- Recognize when patients may benefit from additional support and connect them to

the appropriate team and care navigation and coordination services and supports.



Administrative & Financial Support

- Process patient copays and coinsurance, coordinating with billing staff as needed.

- Coordinate with the patient IT support team to provide basic technical support for

patients preparing for virtual visits (video setup, log-in troubleshooting).

Requirements

- 2–3+ years of experience in healthcare, medical reception, patient services, or call

center support (U.S. healthcare experience required).

- Registered Nurse (RN) license strongly preferred but not required — candidates

with an RN background may be especially well-suited given the patient population,

though this is a non-clinical role.

- Excellent phone presence and communication skills, with the ability to speak

clearly and empathetically with older adults.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage multiple

priorities.

- Familiarity with virtual care platforms, scheduling systems, and collaboration tools

(e.g., EMRs, Zoom, Slack, call center software).

- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- Must be available to work U.S. business hours (Eastern Time or Pacific Time

coverage).



What We Offer

- Full-time, fully remote role (40+ hours/week).

- Competitive compensation with opportunities for advancement.

- A stable, long-term position with a mission-driven U.S. healthcare company.

- Training and mentorship in dementia care and patient experience excellence.

- Career progression opportunities in care navigation, clinical operations, patient

experience, or quality assurance.

- A chance to shape the future of dementia and brain health care delivery

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
TECHNICAL PROJECT MANAGER & CLIENT SUCCESS MANAGER

Low-Voltage Telecommunications and Network Infrastructure



Company: Integrated Staffing

Location: Remote – Philippines

Schedule: Part-Time Initially, With Opportunity to Expand to Full-Time

Required Availability: U.S. Eastern Time overlap

Compensation: Based on experience, plus project-profitability incentives



ABOUT INTEGRATED STAFFING



Integrated Staffing supports U.S.-based clients with staffing, coordination and project delivery for low-voltage telecommunications, structured cabling, fiber, networking, access control, Wi-Fi, technical infrastructure and field-service projects.



We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager & Client Success Manager who can take ownership of projects from initial scope review through completion, client acceptance, invoicing and payment.



This is not a general administrative project-management position. Applicants must understand low-voltage systems, network infrastructure, switches, routers and telecommunications equipment well enough to communicate credibly with clients and technicians, recognize project risks and protect project profitability.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Project Planning and Launch



* Review statements of work, drawings, schedules, client requirements and project assumptions.

* Identify missing information, scope gaps, technical risks and unrealistic expectations before work begins.

* Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, staffing plans and communication schedules.

* Determine technician qualifications, labor requirements, materials, equipment, travel and site-access needs.

* Coordinate kickoff meetings with clients, technicians, subcontractors, vendors and internal team members.

* Confirm that sites, materials, equipment and personnel are ready before deployment.

* Establish and monitor the approved project budget and targeted gross-profit margin.



Technical Project Management



* Manage low-voltage telecommunications and network-infrastructure projects.

* Understand and discuss structured cabling, copper, fiber, switches, routers, wireless access points and related equipment.

* Review technical requirements and ask appropriate questions when information is unclear.

* Coordinate equipment installation, replacement, cabling, testing, labeling and documentation.

* Assign technicians with the correct skills and certifications.

* Identify potential technical problems before they cause delays, rework or cost overruns.

* Communicate technical information clearly between clients, field teams and internal stakeholders.

* Escalate issues requiring engineering, programming or executive approval.



Field-Team Coordination



* Coordinate leads, technicians, helpers, subcontractors and vendors.

* Conduct regular field-team check-ins and maintain accurate project-status records.

* Track attendance, time, completed work, productivity and remaining scope.

* Confirm that technicians submit required daily reports, photographs, test results, receipts and time records.

* Address attendance, performance, communication and documentation problems promptly.

* Resolve scheduling, travel, lodging, access, equipment and material issues.

* Maintain accountability while treating employees, contractors and clients professionally.



Budget and Profitability Management



* Maintain a current project budget showing revenue, labor, payroll costs, overtime, travel, lodging, per diem, materials, shipping, subcontractors and equipment expenses.

* Compare estimated, committed and actual project costs.

* Forecast final project gross profit and immediately report potential margin loss.

* Prevent unauthorized overtime, purchases and scope expansion.

* Confirm that out-of-scope work is documented and approved through a written change order.

* Track change-order status and ensure approved additional work is included in billing.

* Work with bookkeeping to assign costs to the correct project.

* Explain budget variances and recommend corrective action.



Client Communication and Retention



* Serve as a dependable point of contact for assigned clients.

* Provide accurate, timely and professional project updates.

* Document client expectations, decisions, approvals and changes.

* Follow up on every commitment and ensure that client questions are answered.

* Address concerns before they become complaints or lost relationships.

* Maintain client follow-up before, during and after each project.

* Conduct post-project follow-up and identify future staffing or project opportunities.

* Help convert successful projects into repeat work and long-term relationships.

* Never make unauthorized contractual, pricing or spending commitments.



Quality Control and Closeout



* Confirm that completed work meets the approved scope and client requirements.

* Track punch-list items through final completion.

* Collect test results, labeling records, photographs, as-built information, signed work tickets and client acceptance.

* Verify that employee time, expenses, receipts and subcontractor documentation are complete.

* Prepare a billing-ready project-closeout package immediately after completion.

* Coordinate with bookkeeping to support prompt and accurate invoicing.

* Maintain organized project files that can support billing, collections, audits or disputes.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE



Applicants must understand:



* Low-voltage telecommunications systems

* Structured cabling

* Cat5e, Cat6 and Cat6A cabling

* Copper termination and testing

* Fiber-optic cabling, connectors, termination and testing

* Network switches and routers

* Wireless access points

* Racks, cabinets, patch panels and cable management

* MDF and IDF telecommunications rooms

* Cable pathways, labeling and certification

* Basic network diagrams and equipment layouts

* Access-control and other low-voltage systems

* Telecommunications-equipment installation and replacement

* Site surveys, bills of materials and statements of work

* Technician skill requirements

* Field testing and closeout documentation

* Basic safety requirements for ladders and aerial lifts



The Project Manager is not necessarily expected to configure or program every device. However, the person must understand the equipment and installation process well enough to recognize problems, evaluate technician qualifications and communicate effectively with technical clients and field teams.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* At least three years of technical project-management experience

* Direct experience in low-voltage, telecommunications, networking, structured cabling, fiber, access control, IT infrastructure or comparable technical field services

* Experience managing projects from planning through closeout

* Experience coordinating technicians, subcontractors, vendors and clients

* Experience managing project budgets and monitoring profitability

* Strong client-facing communication skills

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines

* Ability to work independently without constant reminders

* Comfortable identifying problems, asking questions and escalating concerns

* Availability for consistent overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours

* Reliable high-speed internet, computer and professional workspace

* Proficiency with spreadsheets and project-management platforms



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Five or more years of technical project-management experience

* Experience supporting U.S.-based telecommunications or field-service clients

* PMP, CAPM, or comparable project-management training

* Experience with QuickBooks, ADP, Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace

* Experience with Smartsheet or similar systems

* Experience with job costing, margin forecasting and change orders

* Experience recovering an at-risk or unprofitable project

* Experience resolving serious client concerns and retaining client relationships



WEEKLY REPORTING



The Project Manager will provide a weekly report showing:



* Project status and milestone progress

* Staffing and technician performance

* Schedule risks and delays

* Budgeted versus actual costs

* Forecasted gross profit

* Missing documentation and approvals

* Open change orders

* Client concerns and satisfaction

* Punch-list and closeout status

* Billing and payment status

* Recommended actions and responsible parties



PERFORMANCE MEASURES



Success will be measured by:



* Projects completed on time and within approved scope

* Project profitability

* Accuracy of budget and margin forecasts

* Timely identification of project risks

* Complete field and closeout documentation

* Reduced rework, unauthorized overtime and preventable expenses

* Speed of closeout and invoicing readiness

* Client satisfaction and repeat business

* Technician accountability and productivity

* Accuracy and responsiveness of communication



COMPENSATION



Compensation is based on experience, technical knowledge, demonstrated results and scheduled hours.



* Initial part-time base

* Opportunity to expand to full-time compensation depending on experience 

* Additional project-profitability incentive based on collected project gross profit

* Compensation and performance review after a successful 90-day introductory period



Candidates with direct experience managing U.S.-based low-voltage, structured-cabling, fiber, networking, access-control or telecommunications projects may qualify for the higher end of the range.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word “MARGIN” to confirm that you read the complete posting.



Please provide:



1. Your current résumé

2. Your expected monthly compensation for both part-time and full-time work

3. A description of the low-voltage, telecommunications or network-infrastructure projects you have managed

4. The approximate project budgets and team sizes you managed

5. An example of a project you prevented from losing money

6. An example of how you resolved a serious client concern

7. Your experience with switches, routers, structured cabling, fiber and telecommunications equipment

8. The project-management and financial-tracking systems you have used

9. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time

10. Two professional references

11. Photographs of previous projects



Applicants whose experience is limited to administrative task coordination without responsibility for technical projects, field teams, project budgets, profitability and client relationships will not be considered.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS

Preferred:

DO NOT APPLY IF:

nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

title: Labor Compliance Specialist/Auditor
description:
Position Overview



Veracity Compliance, Inc. is seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and organized Labor Compliance Specialist / Auditor to support the review, auditing, and administration of labor compliance requirements for public works, federally funded, and other regulated construction projects. The ideal candidate must be able to follow instructions carefully, adhere to established workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintain accurate and orderly documentation, and consistently complete detailed processes without skipping required steps.



This is not strictly an administrative compliance position. We are specifically seeking a candidate with a strong auditing and accounting background who is comfortable reviewing payroll records, reconciling financial information, identifying discrepancies, documenting findings, and conducting detailed compliance reviews.



The ideal candidate understands how financial records connect and has experience in auditing, accounting, Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), payroll, or financial reconciliation. Prior labor compliance or construction experience is highly preferred but may not be required for an exceptional accounting/audit candidate who can learn regulatory requirements quickly.



A CPA, CPA candidate, or candidate with formal accounting/auditing credentials is strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities:



Labor Compliance & Auditing



Conduct detailed audits of contractor and subcontractor labor compliance documentation.

Review Certified Payroll Reports (CPRs) for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

Compare payroll records against supporting documentation to identify inconsistencies or potential violations.

Audit employee classifications, wage rates, fringe benefits, hours worked, overtime, deductions, and payroll calculations.

Identify underpayments, overpayments, missing documentation, discrepancies, and other compliance deficiencies.

Review payroll registers, timecards, proof of payment, canceled checks, direct-deposit records, invoices, and other supporting financial documentation.

Calculate potential wage restitution and document the basis for audit findings.

Maintain detailed audit trails and supporting documentation.

Prepare clear audit findings, deficiency notices, and compliance correspondence.

Follow up with contractors and subcontractors regarding outstanding deficiencies and corrective actions.

Assist with internal and external compliance audits and investigations.

Accounting & Financial Review

Perform detailed reconciliations between payroll, accounting records, supporting documentation, and compliance submissions.

Review AP and AR documentation when relevant to compliance verification.

Trace transactions and payments through supporting accounting records.

Identify mathematical errors, duplicate transactions, inconsistencies, missing payments, and unsupported amounts.

Analyze spreadsheets and large volumes of financial information with a high degree of accuracy.

Verify calculations independently rather than relying solely on information provided by contractors.

Maintain organized records capable of supporting an audit, investigation, or agency review.

Public Works & Prevailing Wage Compliance



Depending on experience and assigned projects, responsibilities may include:



California prevailing wage compliance

Davis-Bacon / Davis-Bacon Related Acts

Certified payroll auditing

DIR requirements and eCPR

WH-347 payroll review

Prevailing wage determinations

Fringe benefit verification

Worker classification review

Overtime requirements

Apprenticeship requirements

DAS 140 and DAS 142 documentation

Apprenticeship ratios

Restitution calculations

Contractor and subcontractor compliance

Agency and client audit preparation

Labor compliance tracking systems and reporting



Training may be provided on specific labor compliance regulations and systems for candidates with exceptional accounting and auditing qualifications.



REQUIRED Qualifications



Candidates must have professional experience in auditing, accounting, or financial review, including experience with Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), payroll, reconciliations, or similar accounting functions.

title: Executive Assistant / Personal Operations| $7 - $8 / hr
description:
# Executive Assistant + Personal Operations | AI & Automation | $7–$8/hr



**Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term**



I’m a US-based physician, entrepreneur, and founder looking for an exceptional **Executive Assistant / Personal Operations Coordinator** who can become my long-term right hand.



This role is about much more than completing tasks.



I’m looking for someone who genuinely enjoys **making another person’s life easier, more organized, and more efficient** - someone who notices loose ends, follows things through to completion, and continuously improves the systems around them.



The long-term goal is to build an increasingly effective **operating system for my professional and personal life**, so that less administrative work depends on me and more of my time is available for high-value work, health, relationships, and life.



## What You’ll Help Own



You will work across several businesses and areas of my personal life, including:



* Managing and organizing my
 inbox

* Drafting and eventually handling routine
 communication

* Making sure important messages, requests, and follow-ups never disappear

* Managing my calendar, meetings, appointments, and scheduling

* Coordinating communication through
, WhatsApp, and other channels

* Tracking tasks, commitments, deadlines, and things other people owe me

* Coordinating with accountants, attorneys, vendors, contractors, team members, and other professionals

* Organizing documents, forms, bills, tax records, contracts, and important files

* Helping coordinate personal appointments, health-related scheduling and records, travel, reservations, events, purchases, and other life administration

* Researching options and bringing me concise recommendations

* Keeping recurring personal and business obligations organized

* Creating SOPs and systems for things we do repeatedly

* Using ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools to work faster and better

* Identifying repetitive work that can be automated, simplified, delegated, or eliminated

* Building or helping implement automations using Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar tools



## The Person I’m Looking For



The most important qualities are **ownership, organization, judgment, and follow-through**.



You should be someone who:



* Is extremely organized and conscientious

* Naturally follows up until something is actually completed

* Notices details other people miss

* Communicates clearly and comfortably

* Has excellent written and spoken English

* Is trustworthy and highly discreet

* Can manage multiple moving pieces without becoming overwhelmed

* Thinks ahead instead of waiting for instructions

* Enjoys creating structure from chaos

* Can prioritize what actually matters

* Is comfortable making recommendations

* Learns how I think and gradually handles more independently

* Enjoys technology, AI, systems, and efficiency

* Wants to improve processes rather than repeat inefficient ones forever



**Operations experience is a major plus.**



Experience supporting a founder, executive, physician, entrepreneur, or multiple businesses is also highly valuable.



## A Very Important Part of This Role



I do not want someone who finishes their task list and then waits for more work.



If everything assigned is complete, I want someone who naturally thinks:



**What are we waiting on?

What is coming up next?

What could fall through the cracks?

What can I organize now?

What can I simplify?

What are we still doing manually that could be automated?

What could I take off his plate next?**



That mindset matters more to me than knowing every software tool on Day 1.



## AI & Automation



You should already be comfortable with **ChatGPT and/or Claude** and interested in becoming significantly better with AI.



You may use AI for:



*
 drafting

* Research

* Summaries

* Document review

* Meeting preparation

* Organizing information

* Creating SOPs

* Comparing options

* Building workflows

* Creating reusable prompts and systems



Core Skills: Executive Assistance •
 Management • Calendar Management • Project/Operations Management • Google Workspace • Excellent English Communication • ChatGPT/AI. AI and specific skills for organizational software (Notion, Slack etc.) offer a strong advantage, but resourcefulness and willingness to learn are more important than knowing every platform.



## What Success Looks Like



Over time:



* I rarely need to monitor my own inbox

* My calendar and scheduling largely run without me

* Important follow-ups never depend on my memory

* My documents and administrative responsibilities stay organized

* You know what is happening across my different ventures

* You know what we are waiting for and proactively chase it

* Personal and professional obligations stop becoming last-minute emergencies

* You anticipate many needs before I ask

* Repetitive work becomes increasingly automated

* Our systems improve every month

* The amount of administrative noise reaching me continually decreases



Ultimately, I want you to become someone I trust to help **run the operating system around my life**, not simply someone I send tasks to.



## Compensation



**$7–$8 USD/hour depending on experience and capability**



* Full-time

* Long-term position

* Stable opportunity

* Eastern Time (US)



For the right person, I want this to become a role with increasing trust, responsibility, autonomy, and opportunity over time.



Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week. US Eastern time working hours. Typical schedule will include Monday - Friday with a shorter Saturday shift for planning, personal administration, systems improvement, and upcoming week preparation. All within the 40 hours. Exact schedule can be finalized with the right candidate.



## How to Apply



Please start your application with the word **LEVERAGE** so I know you read the entire posting.



Then answer these questions:



1. Tell me about the most demanding executive, founder, or business owner you have supported. What were you personally responsible for?



2. Imagine I want to stop routinely checking my own inbox. How would you gradually take ownership of it while making sure nothing important is missed?



3. Tell me about a time you noticed something needed to be done **without being asked** and took ownership of it.



4. What is one process you have improved, simplified, or automated? AI examples are welcome.



5. What AI tools and automation platforms do you currently use?



6. Imagine it is Friday afternoon. I have 15 unread important
s, three people who owe me documents, two appointments next week that still need coordination, and I haven't given you any new tasks today. Briefly tell me what you would do.





Please also include a **60–90 second video introduction**.



Please don't make the video overly formal or scripted. I want to understand how you communicate and whether we would enjoy working together every day.



I am looking for someone who wants to **grow with me for years**, become deeply trusted, and help create more order, simplicity, and leverage as my businesses and responsibilities continue to grow.

title: High-Ticket B2B Cold Caller / Sales Representative ($5/hr + 10% Commission)
description:
About R&J Agency

At R&J Agency, we help small and medium-sized businesses across the US upgrade their online presence. Our core service is building modern, high-converting business websites starting at $649, along with additional services like Website Care and Ad Creatives.



We do not hard-sell or push outdated sales tactics. Instead, we use a high-value "Free Demo" strategy: we show qualified business owners a custom, risk-free website preview before asking them to buy.



What We Offer (Compensation & Benefits)



Hourly Base Pay: $5.00 per hour worked (paid from Day 1).



High-Ticket Commission: 10% commission on all closed website sales.

Example: A standard $649 sale earns you $64.90. A $1,500 sale earns you $150.00.  



Trial Period (First 2 Days):You get paid $5/hour + 10% commission right away.  

Leads are 100% provided by us during your first 2 days so you can focus purely on calling, handling objections, and booking free previews.  



How the Role Works



Outreach & Prospecting: Contact US business owners (no website or outdated website). (Leads provided during trial; self-sourced after trial).  



Offer Value: Pitch a FREE, no-obligation website preview using our pre-built sector templates.  



Follow-Up & Close: Show the prospect their customized demo, demonstrate the business value, and close the sale.  



Handoff: Once the client pays, R&J Agency handles all technical delivery and onboarding.  



Requirements & Qualifications



Fluent Spoken English: Clear pronunciation, strong conversational flow, and professional tone.  



Sales Experience: Previous cold calling, B2B sales, or appointment setting experience is required.  



Natural Phone Presence: You don't read word-for-word from a script; you have natural conversations with business owners.  



Relentless Follow-Up: Strong discipline in keeping CRM notes and following up when promised.  



Equipment: Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a noise-canceling headset.



How to Apply

If you are a driven sales rep who wants a stable hourly base + uncapped commission potential, reply to this job post with: 



A brief introduction about your B2B sales/cold calling experience.



A link to a 1-minute voice recording (via Vocaroo, Google Drive, or Loom) introducing yourself. (Applications without a voice sample will not be reviewed).



Looking forward to bringing our next top closer onto the team!

title: Elite Acquisitions Closer U.S. Real Estate | Remote | USD Pay
description:
We run a high margin U.S. real estate niche most investors can't touch: partial deeds and title problems. We help families untangle complicated ownership and unlock properties nobody else knows how to close. The deals are unusual, the margins are strong, and the best closer on our team is closing roughly one deal a week.



We're hiring one more sharp closer. The bar is high on purpose.





What This Is





A real sales seat. You research families, get on the phone every day, and build trust with people in hard situations.

This is not a VA role. Not admin. Not "manage a pipeline quietly." You dial, you talk, you move deals.

You'll own leads inside Lofty (our CRM), dial through Dialpad, and pull contacts with SmartSkip.





Your Day





Daily huddle, 10:00 AM ET, cameras on, no exceptions. We review numbers, wins, and blockers together.

75 dials per day minimum, tracked. Your dials, contacts, and conversion are visible to the team every day.

Roughly 40 to 50% research (obituaries, court and tax records, identifying heirs and the real decision maker) and 50 to 60% outreach (calls, texts, voi
s, follow up).

We run a two call close structure. You'll learn it cold.





How We Operate (so you know before you apply)





We track activity daily. If you go dark for a day with no heads up, you won't last here.

We coach hard and expect you to be coachable. B+ players who show up beat A players who don't.

Full training from day one. Clear path to Senior Closer and team lead as you prove out.







What You Need





English at C1/C2 only. Families need to trust your voice on the phone.

5+ years sales experience. Real estate (acquisitions, wholesaling, probate, title) strongly preferred.

Total comfort with daily outbound calling, voi
s, and relentless follow up.

Sharp judgment on who the real decision maker is inside a family.

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, quality headset. Non negotiable.





Schedule





Full time, Monday to Friday

10:00 AM to 7:30 PM Eastern Time





Pay





Base: $1,000 to $1,500 USD per month based on experience

Commission: 10 to 15% depending on deal revenue. Our average deal is over $30,000, so a single close pays well.

Realistic total once ramped: $8,000 per month

Be clear eyed on timing: most reps lock their first deal within 30 days, and commission on that deal pays out around 100 days later once it closes and funds. This niche pays big, but it is not instant money. If you need a paycheck next week, this isn't the seat.







How to Apply



Send a 1 to 2 minute video covering:





Your sales and real estate background

How comfortable you truly are with heavy daily outbound calling

Why you're great at finding and speaking to the right decision maker in a family

Your location and availability
