title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $1,000+/mo — Established TikTok Pages (Long-Term Role)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



This application requires a paid test video. It takes about an hour and I pay $25 USD for it whether or not I hire you.



Applications without a test video are deleted unread. Not set aside, not reviewed later - deleted. I've run this post before without the test as a hard requirement and got thirty applications I couldn't tell apart. I'd rather read five real edits than fifty resumes.



If that's not something you want to do, no hard feelings, but please don't apply - you'll be spending your time for nothing.



INTERVIEWS HAVE ALREADY STARTED. There is no closing date because there doesn't need to be one. I'm reviewing tests as they arrive and interviewing the strong ones the same week. The moment I find the right editor this post comes down. If you're reading this and you want the role, do the test today. Every day you wait is a day the seat is more likely already filled.



THE TEST



Folder (everything you need is in here):





Inside, you'll find the reference video, the raw footage, and a "Further Directions" file. Read that file before you start.



POSITION



Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $1,000+/mo — Established TikTok Pages (Long-Term Role)



TYPE / SALARY



Full Time · 5–6 days per week · PH or similar time zone $1,000 USD/month starting, potential for performance bonuses. Raises tied to skill and results.



JOB DESCRIPTION



I run TikTok pages that consistently reach millions of views. I'm looking for one editor to take ownership of the editing work alongside me, long term.



Success in this role comes down to two things above all else: editing quality and English comprehension. Because of that, this posting is specific about what the work requires, and the application asks for more than a résumé. I'd rather be clear upfront than have either of us discover a mismatch a month in.



THE WORK



Daily short-form vertical content — talking heads and voiceover/b-roll:



Cutting dead space so videos stay paced and never drag

Stitching the strongest takes into one seamless piece

Adding image overlays on screen to support what's being said

Zooms, crops, and reframes to keep the frame dynamic

B-roll builds: I provide a voiceover and footage, you find the visual that matches each line

Sourcing your own overlay assets — reading the script and independently finding the images it calls for



The last two items are the core of the role. The rest is technical work most editors can learn. Choosing the right visual for the right sentence is what separates a video that reaches 4,000 people from one that reaches 4,000,000.



SOURCING YOUR OWN ASSETS



This is one of the most important parts of the job, and the part most editors are not set up for. I'll give you background and direction, but I want you fully self-sufficient at finding the visuals a script needs. That means:



Reading the script and working out which images the moment actually calls for

Finding high-quality, aesthetically strong photos of the celebrities and influencers being discussed — not the first search result, but the image that looks right on screen

Learning the brands I work with well enough to represent them correctly

Knowing which parts of a brand's website are worth capturing, and pulling clean screenshots of them

Sourcing relevant comments, posts, and screenshots that support the point being made

Placing every asset at the right moment in the video, on the beat the script lands on



I shouldn't have to send you an image folder for a video to get made. You should be able to take the script and go find what it needs.



This requires genuinely understanding English — hearing a sentence and catching the humor, the tone, the reference — because you can't source the right image for a line you don't fully understand. Your English does not need to be perfect. It needs to be strong enough that you follow everything being said and that we can communicate quickly and clearly. Familiarity with internet and pop culture is a significant advantage here, and it's rewarded.



EXAMPLES OF THE WORK



Please watch all three before applying so you know exactly what you'd be producing.



Basic talking head — cutting dead space, piecing clips together, light crops and zooms: 

Talking head with overlays — the same, plus supplied images placed on screen: 

B-roll — a voiceover with footage matched to it line by line. This is where English comprehension shows most: 



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

Strong attention to detail. You catch the frame held a beat too long or the overlay that sits slightly off. This is the most important quality in the role.

Self-sufficiency with assets. You can take a script and go find the images it needs without being handed a folder. This is weighted as heavily as your editing.

Willingness to go the extra step. Reviewing your own export once more and fixing what wasn't flagged.

Strong English comprehension. Understanding is essential; polished speaking and writing is a bonus.

Responsive communication. When I message during working hours, I need a reply promptly rather than the following day.

Exclusivity. This is a full-time position and I'm looking for someone working with me only — no other clients, agencies, or subcontracting. In return you get stability, a real salary, and an employer invested in your growth.

A long-term outlook. I'm hiring someone to grow with these pages over years, not to fill a short-term gap.



This role likely isn't the right fit if you're applying broadly today, prefer briefs explained in detail more than once, or intend to use AI to write your application answers — I'm looking for your own thinking.



REQUIREMENTS

Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (TikTok / Reels / Shorts)

CapCut or any software you work quickly in — the output is what matters

Confident sourcing your own images, screenshots, and reference material online, with good taste in what looks right on screen

Reliable internet and a computer that handles daily editing without issues

Available full time, with reasonable overlap with my hours. The volume moves with the content schedule — some weeks run 4–5 days, others run 6–7. I need someone who can flex with it rather than hold to a fixed number of days

Able to receive payment via Wise

Comfortable receiving direct feedback and applying it the first time

PAY AND GROWTH



$1,000 USD/month paid through Wise, with potential for performance bonuses. The ceiling on this role sits well above the starting salary — as you learn the pages and begin contributing your own ideas, your compensation grows accordingly. You'd be working directly with me each day on pages already reaching millions of views.



HOW TO APPLY



Subject line: EDITOR — [number of the example video above you think is hardest to edit] (For example: EDITOR — 2. Applications that don't follow this format won't be reviewed.)



Please include in your message:



Links to 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited, and what you handled on each. If you worked on only part of a video, please say so — accuracy matters more to me than scope.

In your own words, 3–5 sentences, without AI assistance: watch example #3 and describe one editing choice that worked well and one you would have approached differently. There's no right answer — I'm interested in how you evaluate a video.

The software you use and how long you've worked in it.

Your internet speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal) and your typical available hours in PH time.

One sentence on your current work and why you're looking to move.



Paid test — $25 USD. Shortlisted applicants receive a Google Drive folder containing the reference video plus the original voiceover takes and footage. You'll stitch together the strongest takes, match footage to the voiceover, and send back your version. Note that the folder deliberately does not contain every image the script calls for — part of the test is sourcing the missing visuals yourself and placing them where they belong. It should take about an hour. This test is paid $25 USD regardless of the hiring outcome — I don't ask anyone to work unpaid.



Google Drive (reference video and source files): 
/drive/folders/1En-NvVg9Fnfc7gdtdbv0xX5y4kAB-e5W?usp=sharing



A strong test is followed by a short call, and then a start date. I review every application that follows the instructions above.

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER / B2B SALES EXECUTIVE Low-Voltage Telecommunications, Technical Field Services and Staffing
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER / B2B SALES EXECUTIVE

Low-Voltage Telecommunications, Technical Field Services and Staffing



Company: Integrated Staffing

Location: Remote – Philippines

Schedule: Full-Time

Required Availability: U.S. Eastern Time

Compensation: Paid Introductory Period + Base Salary + Uncapped Commission



ABOUT INTEGRATED STAFFING



Integrated Staffing supports U.S.-based clients with staffing and project-delivery solutions for low-voltage telecommunications, structured cabling, fiber, access control, Wi-Fi, networking, technical infrastructure and field services.



We are seeking an experienced Business Development Manager who can identify, pursue and close profitable business with U.S.-based organizations.



This is not a passive lead-generation or administrative sales-support position. The successful candidate must actively find decision-makers, initiate conversations, qualify opportunities, conduct discovery calls, follow up consistently and help convert qualified opportunities into signed, profitable agreements.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Prospecting and Pipeline Development



* Identify U.S.-based companies that need low-voltage, telecommunications, network-infrastructure, field-service or staffing support.

* Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, industry directories, procurement portals, referrals, professional associations and online research.

* Conduct outbound prospecting through telephone calls,
, LinkedIn and other approved channels.

* Identify and contact decision-makers in operations, facilities, information technology, construction, procurement, project management and vendor management.

* Develop relationships with direct clients, general contractors, technology integrators, manufacturers, healthcare organizations, data centers, logistics companies, retailers and other qualified organizations.

* Maintain a consistent pipeline of prospects, qualified opportunities, proposals and follow-up activities.

* Re-engage previous and inactive clients when authorized.



Discovery and Qualification



* Conduct professional discovery calls with U.S.-based prospects.

* Understand the client’s technical requirements, locations, schedule, budget, decision process and purchasing requirements.

* Determine whether opportunities align with the company’s capabilities, pricing and risk standards.

* Identify whether an opportunity involves direct project work, staffing, project delivery or another service model.

* Recognize unprofitable, poorly defined or excessively risky opportunities.

* Collect the information necessary for leadership to make an informed bid-or-no-bid decision.

* Verify decision-makers, purchasing authority, expected timelines and next steps.

* Assess potential clients for payment risk, contract requirements and long-term value.



Sales and Closing



* Present Integrated Staffing’s capabilities professionally and accurately.

* Coordinate technical discussions with operations and project-management personnel.

* Prepare or assist with proposals, presentations, capability statements and follow-up materials.

* Maintain consistent follow-up throughout long sales cycles.

* Address objections and explain the value of the company’s services.

* Support contract discussions while ensuring all pricing and terms receive proper approval.

* Move qualified prospects toward signed agreements and active projects.

* Never make unauthorized promises concerning pricing, staffing, schedules, credit terms, technical capabilities or contractual obligations.

* Never approve contracts, discounts, purchases or pricing without authorization.



Client Development and Retention



* Maintain regular communication with new and existing clients.

* Support a professional transition from sales into project delivery.

* Remain involved after the sale to confirm that expectations are being met.

* Identify additional locations, departments, services and future opportunities.

* Work with project management to address concerns before they damage the client relationship.

* Help turn successful initial projects into repeat business and long-term accounts.

* Maintain accurate records of client commitments, preferences and future needs.

* Conduct structured post-project follow-up to identify additional opportunities.



TECHNICAL UNDERSTANDING



Candidates should understand:



* Low-voltage telecommunications

* Structured cabling

* Cat5e, Cat6 and Cat6A cabling

* Fiber-optic cabling

* Network switches and routers

* Wireless access points

* Racks, cabinets and patch panels

* MDF and IDF telecommunications rooms

* Access-control systems

* Network-infrastructure deployments

* Technical field-service work

* Site surveys

* Bills of materials

* Statements of work

* Technician qualifications and certifications



The salesperson is not expected to engineer or program systems. However, the person must understand the services well enough to ask appropriate questions, accurately represent company capabilities and avoid selling work that cannot be delivered safely or profitably.



CRM AND REPORTING



The Business Development Manager must maintain complete and accurate CRM records, including:



* Prospect and company name

* Decision-maker and contact information

* Lead source

* Services needed

* Estimated opportunity value

* Expected gross margin

* Last contact and next action

* Proposal and contract status

* Probability of closing

* Expected decision date

* Reasons opportunities were won or lost



Weekly reporting must include:



* Outbound calls,
s and LinkedIn outreach

* New decision-makers contacted

* Conversations completed

* Qualified discovery meetings

* New opportunities created

* Proposals submitted

* Estimated pipeline value

* Agreements signed

* Collected revenue and gross profit

* Stalled opportunities and recommended actions

* Client-retention and expansion activity



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



*Must have previous experience bidding government telecommunications projects and must have awarded contracts   

*At least three years of successful B2B sales or business-development experience

* Experience prospecting and selling to U.S.-based companies

* Demonstrated ability to find prospects rather than relying exclusively on inbound leads

* Experience conducting discovery calls, presenting services and closing business

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Confident and professional telephone communication

* Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills

* Experience using a CRM

* Ability to manage a long and complex sales process

* Strong judgment concerning client quality, risk and profitability

* Ability to work independently and remain productive without constant supervision

* Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours

* Reliable high-speed internet, computer, headset and quiet professional workspace



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience selling low-voltage, telecommunications, structured-cabling, fiber, networking, access-control, IT-infrastructure or technical field services

* Experience selling staffing, recruiting or project-based services

* Existing relationships with U.S. contractors, integrators, manufacturers, facilities teams or procurement departments

* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or another CRM

* Experience responding to RFPs, vendor-registration opportunities or procurement requests

* Experience selling services with project values exceeding $1,000,000

* Proven history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

* Experience expanding small accounts into long-term client relationships



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Success will be measured by:



* Quality and accuracy of targeted prospect lists

* Consistent outbound prospecting

* Conversations with appropriate decision-makers

* Qualified discovery meetings

* Legitimate opportunities created

* Pipeline quality and estimated value

* Proposal-to-close conversion rate

* New clients acquired

* Collected sales

* Collected gross profit

* Contract quality and payment terms

* Client retention and repeat business

* CRM accuracy and follow-up consistency



The long-term objective is to help build a sales pipeline capable of producing at least $2 million in annual collected revenue while maintaining approved profitability and risk standards.



COMPENSATION AND PAID INTRODUCTORY PERIOD



This position begins with a 60-day paid introductory period.



During the introductory period:



* Base compensation depending on experience 

* Uncapped commission eligibility from the first day

* Leads provided

* Clear weekly activity, pipeline and reporting expectations



After successful completion of the 60-day introductory period:



* Base salary will increase based on experience and progression 

*A full time assistant will be provided 

* Uncapped commission will continue

* Additional bonuses may be available for exceeding quarterly collected-sales and gross-profit targets

* Long-term growth opportunities may include Senior Business Development Manager or Sales Director responsibilities

*Possibility of travel to the USA to meet the team

Commission is based on collected gross profit from qualified business personally originated by the salesperson. Commission is earned only after the client has paid and the associated direct project costs have been recorded.



The specific commission percentage, eligibility period and payment schedule will be included in the written compensation agreement.



INTRODUCTORY-PERIOD EVALUATION



The salesperson will not be evaluated solely on closed revenue during the introductory period because complex B2B sales may require a longer sales cycle.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Understanding of the company’s services and ideal clients

* Quality and accuracy of target prospect lists

* Consistent outbound calls,
s and LinkedIn outreach

* Conversations with appropriate U.S.-based decision-makers

* Qualified discovery meetings scheduled and completed

* Legitimate opportunities added to the CRM

* Estimated pipeline value and gross-profit potential

* Quality of discovery notes and follow-up

* Proposals or pricing opportunities developed

* Accuracy and consistency of CRM records

* Professional communication and reliability

* Ability to identify and reject unqualified or excessively risky opportunities



Continuation after the introductory period is not automatic. The salesperson must demonstrate consistent effort, sound judgment, professional communication and the ability to build a credible pipeline of profitable opportunities.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word “PIPELINE” to confirm that you read the complete posting.



Please provide:



1. Your current résumé

2. Your experience selling to U.S.-based businesses

3. The products or services you have sold

4. Your average sale size and sales-cycle length

5. Your individual sales targets and actual results

6. Your largest personally originated and closed account

7. An example of a client you found through cold prospecting

8. Your experience with low-voltage, telecommunications, networking, field services or staffing

9. The prospecting and CRM tools you have used

10. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time

11. A short voice or video introduction demonstrating your spoken English

12. Two professional references who can verify your sales results



Applicants whose experience is limited to data entry, customer service, social-media posting or appointment setting without responsibility for developing and closing B2B opportunities will not be considered.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS

title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Sunday - Friday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT | Tuesday - Sunday 10 AM - 8 PM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

title: US Product Sourcing Specialist – Amazon FBA Private Label
description:
We are building an Amazon FBA private-label business and are looking for an experienced Product Sourcing Specialist to help us identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers for products we have already researched and validated.



Our preference is for someone with strong experience sourcing from manufacturers and suppliers within the United States, ideally with an existing supplier network or proven methods for identifying qualified domestic manufacturers.



Key Responsibilities

•?  ?Source manufacturers, contract manufacturers, wholesalers, and suppliers for approved Amazon FBA product concepts.

•?  ?Prioritize U.S.-based manufacturers and suppliers whenever commercially viable.

•?  ?Identify multiple supplier options for each product rather than relying on a single source.

•?  ?Send RFQs and collect:

  * Unit pricing

  * MOQs

  * Sample costs

  * Production lead times

  * Packaging options

  * Private-label/custom-branding capabilities

  * Payment terms

  * Shipping and freight information



•?  ?Negotiate pricing, MOQs, payment terms, and other commercial terms.

•?  ?Verify supplier legitimacy, manufacturing capability, and relevant certifications.

•?  ?Coordinate product samples and communicate product specifications and required improvements.

•?  ?Compare suppliers based on quality, cost, reliability, lead time, and overall landed economics.

•?  ?Identify potential sourcing, compliance, quality-control, or supply-chain risks before orders are placed.

•?  ?Maintain clear supplier records, quotes, communication history, and sourcing comparisons.

•?  ?Work closely with our Amazon team to ensure sourced products meet required margins and Amazon FBA requirements.



You should have:



•?  ?Proven experience sourcing products for Amazon FBA and/or private-label businesses.

•?  ?Strong knowledge of U.S. manufacturers, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and distributors.

title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Sunday - Friday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT | Tuesday - Sunday 10 AM - 8 PM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

title: Social Media Engagement Assistant
description:
About the Role

The Venue Playbook is a new education brand for wedding and event venue owners — templates, coaching, and courses built from real, working venue operations. We're launching the Instagram account from zero followers and need someone to handle the research and groundwork side of organic growth: finding the right people to connect with, and flagging where genuine engagement should happen — not writing or posting as the brand. The founder's own voice stays the founder's; this role finds the door, she walks through it.



This role starts scoped to Phase 1 only: engagement and research. It is not a content, copywriting, or community-management role at this stage. As the business grows, there's a defined Phase 2 this role can expand into — see Growth Path below. We're hiring with that trajectory in mind, but the day-to-day work starts, and stays, exactly as scoped in Phase 1 until the business is ready to expand it.

________________________________________

Daily Tasks — Phase 1 Scope

Each day, you'll build a shortlist of accounts and posts across a defined set of wedding-venue-industry hashtags and accounts, sorted into four action types:

1. Follow — accounts you've identified as real venue owners, coaches, or industry educators worth following. You can action these directly (no approval needed).

2. Like — posts worth liking to build presence in the niche. Also actionable directly.

3. Comment here — posts where a genuine, specific comment from the founder would land well. For each one, you'll flag why it's worth a comment in one line (e.g., "she's asking about deposit policies — founder has real experience here" or "new owner venting about vendor insurance, similar to an early struggle of ours"). You do not write or post the comment — you hand off the post and the reasoning, the founder writes the actual words.

4. Story-worthy — content worth reacting to or resharing in Stories, flagged the same way.



Deliverable: a short daily list (roughly 15–20 items total across all four categories) delivered by a set time each day, so the founder can move through it in 10–15 minutes rather than scrolling herself.



What makes something worth flagging (your judgment matters here):

• Real venue owners posting about their own operations — policies, wins, struggles — not couples' personal wedding accounts or adjacent vendors (photographers, florists, DJs).

• Posts with an actual hook to respond to — a question, an opinion, a pain point — not just a pretty photo with nothing to say.

• Active, recently-posted content from real accounts, not stale posts or engagement-pod content.

________________________________________

Hours & Schedule

Part-time to start: roughly 1.5–2 hours/day, 5 days a week (~8–10 hours/week). This can flex — if research on a given day turns up less, it doesn't need to be padded to fill time; if the niche is especially active, a bit more time finding quality over quantity is fine.



Timing is flexible day-to-day, but the daily list needs to land consistently at a set time each day so the founder can act on it before her own day fills up. Exact handoff time to be agreed during onboarding, ideally something that overlaps reasonably with US working hours for quick questions.

________________________________________

Access & Tools

• Access will be granted through Meta Business Suite as a collaborator with content/engagement permissions — never a shared password. This can be revoked cleanly if needed and keeps account security intact.

• Daily lists delivered via shared Google Sheet. 

________________________________________

Who Fits This Role

The founder's working style is high Dominance (40%) and high Compliance (36%), with low Influence (6%) and low Steadiness (18%) — direct, fast-moving, and detail-driven, with clear expectations and not much appetite for back-and-forth or reassurance-seeking. Practically, that means:

• Communicate in short, direct updates. Skip the preamble — lead with the list, the number, the flag. Long explanations or check-in questions where the answer is obvious will slow things down more than help.

• Work independently once the format is set. This role doesn't come with much day-to-day hand-holding — the founder will set clear expectations up front and expect consistent execution against them, not frequent clarification requests.

• Take direct feedback in stride. Feedback will likely be brief and to the point, not softened — the right person reads that as efficient, not personal.

• Bring the relational instinct the role needs, since the founder's own style is low on it. The actual task — sensing which post has a genuine, human moment worth commenting on — leans on social/relational read that isn't the founder's natural strength. A candidate with a warmer, more people-attuned style (even if the founder herself isn't) will likely spot better opportunities than someone purely mechanical about it.

• Steady, consistent follow-through matters more than charisma. The daily list needs to show up the same way, every day, without needing to be chased — reliability reads better here than personality.



In short: someone comfortable being told plainly what's needed and trusted to just do it — but who personally reads social nuance well, since that's the gap this role is filling.

________________________________________

Compensation & Structure

• Starting rate: $8.00–$8.50 USD/hour, based on experience.

• Pay schedule: Bi-weekly. 

o Work from the 1st–15th is paid on the 20th.

o Work from the 16th–30th/31st is paid on the 5th.

• Rate review: After an initial 60–90 day period, rate will be revisited based on performance and consistency. Room to grow for a candidate who proves out.

________________________________________

Growth Path — Phase 2 (Future, Not Immediate)

This role is scoped narrowly on purpose while the business is pre-launch. Phase 1 (engagement and research) is the entire job to start — there's no assumption the role quietly grows on its own. Expansion happens deliberately, once the business is ready for it, likely triggered by things like a growing follower base, launch of the course/coaching products, or simply the founder having validated the working relationship and wanting to hand off more.



When that point comes, Phase 2 could include:

• Scheduling and posting the content calendar

• Basic engagement reporting (what's working, follower growth trends)

• Eventually, more day-to-day social media management



Candidates interested in growing with the business over time are especially welcome — but should come in expecting Phase 1 as the real, ongoing scope, not a trial period for something bigger.

title: AI Video Scene Generator, OMNI Experience Required (Part-Time, Daily)
description:

Volume: 2-3 videos per day, every day. Each video is a handful of scenes. Expect roughly 1-2 hours of actual work daily once you're up to speed. Turnaround same day. Videos run 30 sec to 2.5 min.

/WhatsApp during agreed hours

1. Join the meeting on time (video or voice)

3. Present the campaign proposal we provide

   - Price / rate

   - Payment terms

   - Hybrid / CPA / CPS structures when applicable

   - Repeat collaboration and long-term partnership options

5. Answer questions, handle objections, and push toward a clear agreement

6. Send a written recap after the meeting (terms agreed + next steps)

7. Follow up until the deal is fully confirmed and ready for execution



You are the company’s face in the meeting. Our team supports you with proposals, background info, and internal approval — but YOU lead the conversation and drive the deal to close.



————————————————————————



What you do NOT need to do



• Find KOL lists from scratch

• Send mass cold
s or cold DMs

• Book meetings (our team schedules them for you)



Your focus is 100% on showing up, negotiating well, and closing.



————————————————————————



Requirements



• Excellent English — very fluent, natural, and confident in live video/voice meetings (required)

• Strong professional presence — well-presented on camera, clear communication, trustworthy image

• Female candidates preferred for this client-facing representative role

————————————————————————



Hiring process

We review your CV, photo, and English video intro.

Shortlisted candidates will join a live video call with our team. You will role-play as our company representative in a sample KOL / agent negotiation (e.g. rate discussion, deliverables, CPA/CPS terms). This is to test your English, confidence on camera, and negotiation style.

title: Talent & HR Leader – Recruitment, Hiring, HR & Candidate Endorsement | Full-Time | Remote
description:
Talent & HR Leader – Recruitment, Hiring, HR & Candidate Endorsement | Full-Time | Remote

Location: Remote, Philippines-based preferred

Schedule: Full-Time

Work Hours: U.S. business hours

Compensation: $7-8+/hour, based on experience

Type: Long-Term | Full-Time



About the Role

We are looking for a strong Talent & HR Leader to lead recruitment, hiring, candidate endorsement, and HR/people operations for our Virtual Assistant workforce, especially healthcare-related roles. This is not just a recruiter role, and it's not just an HR role — it's both, combined into one seat. This person will own the full employee lifecycle: building strong talent pipelines, assessing candidate quality, endorsing candidates quickly and accurately, and then carrying that relationship forward through onboarding, employee relations, performance management, policy, and offboarding.



The ideal candidate has experience recruiting Virtual Assistants or remote talent and experience running HR functions for a remote or distributed team — policies, employee relations, performance, compliance — and can manage a disciplined process across both functions with clear metrics, strong follow-through, and high standards. This role requires someone who can balance speed with quality, and who can shift comfortably between hiring mode and people-management mode.



What You'll Own

Talent Acquisition & Hiring

- Recruit capable, culturally aligned Virtual Assistants based on client demand

- Build proactive talent pipelines for current and future roles

- Screen candidates for job capability, communication, professionalism, reliability, and culture fit

- Support hiring for key healthcare, dental, medical, orthodontic, administrative, client-facing, and operations roles

- Maintain strong candidate communication throughout the hiring process

- Negotiate, coordinate, and support hiring decisions as needed

Candidate Endorsement & SLA Management

- Ensure qualified candidates are endorsed to match client demand within required timelines

- Monitor endorsement timelines and intervene when candidates are at risk of missing deadlines

- Keep candidate movement organized and visible across the hiring pipeline

- Escalate stalled candidates, assessment concerns, or client-demand changes quickly

- Support smooth handoff from recruitment into onboarding or placement

HR & People Operations

- Own onboarding from offer acceptance through first 90 days, including documentation, account setup coordination, and orientation

- Serve as the primary HR point of contact for the VA workforce — answering policy questions, handling day-to-day employee relations issues, and escalating serious matters appropriately

- Maintain and evolve HR policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures for a remote Philippines-based workforce

- Manage performance review cycles, PIPs, and documentation of performance or conduct issues

- Track and administer time-off, attendance, and any benefits or incentive programs

- Handle offboarding: exit conversations, knowledge transfer, access revocation coordination, and exit documentation

- Maintain accurate, compliant employee records

- Partner with leadership on compensation bands, promotions, and role changes

- Help build a strong internal culture, employee engagement practices, and retention initiatives across the VA team

Recruiting Operations & Process Improvement

- Manage and improve recruiting workflows, playbooks, templates, and SOPs

- Maintain accurate candidate records and pipeline updates in the ATS

- Use recruitment tools, dashboards, reports, and AI tools to improve hiring efficiency

- Identify bottlenecks in the hiring funnel and recommend improvements

- Standardize how candidates are screened, evaluated, endorsed, and handed off

Team Leadership & Coaching

- Coach recruiters and/or HR team members on screening quality, candidate communication, employee relations handling, and internal standards

- Review quality-of-hire concerns or culture/job-fit misses

- Support consistent evaluation and people-management standards across the team

- Lead with clear communication, accountability, and professionalism

Funnel Management & Reporting

- Review pipeline volume, funnel movement, and time-to-fill across open roles

- Track application volume, assessment pass rates, interview-to-offer conversion, and endorsement timelines

- Report hiring and HR metrics, risks, and recommendations to leadership (turnover, retention, time-to-fill, employee relations trends)

- Identify early patterns by role, client, cohort, source, or recruiter

Onboarding-to-Pool & Retention Support

- Own the full onboarding-to-tenure arc for newly hired VAs, not just the handoff

- Partner with VA Success and Client Success on early-tenure risks

- Monitor 90-day and long-term retention and early performance trends

- Identify whether hiring filters, sourcing channels, screening, or HR/onboarding processes need improvement

- Support long-term retention by improving both hiring quality and the employee experience from day one through tenure



Required Experience

- Experience in talent acquisition, recruiting leadership, or VA hiring

- Experience running HR functions — employee relations, performance management, policy, offboarding — ideally for a remote or distributed team

- Experience assessing both job capability and culture fit

- Strong understanding of high-quality candidate screening and evaluation

- Experience managing hiring pipelines and recruitment metrics

- Strong written and spoken English communication

- Strong judgment and decision-making skills, especially with sensitive employee matters

- Ability to coach recruiters and/or HR team members

- Strong documentation, follow-up, and reporting habits

- Comfortable working with U.S.-based clients, teams, or leadership

- Able to manage multiple open roles, HR cases, and competing priorities simultaneously

- Comfortable using an ATS or recruiting platform, plus HR/HRIS tooling



Healthcare Hiring Experience Preferred — Experience recruiting for healthcare, dental, orthodontic, medical, patient support, insurance, billing, administrative, or healthcare-adjacent roles is a plus. Understanding how to evaluate candidates for healthcare environments — communication, reliability, privacy awareness, documentation, professionalism, and patient/client service standards — is valuable.



What Success Looks Like

- Strong candidates are hired based on client demand and endorsed within required timelines

- Hiring pipelines are clear, active, and well-managed

- New hires have a smooth, well-documented onboarding experience

- Employee relations issues are handled promptly, fairly, and with proper documentation

- HR policies and processes are clear, consistent, and compliant

- Recruiters and/or HR team members are coached toward stronger performance

- Leadership has clear visibility into both hiring and HR metrics and risks

- Retention improves because candidates are better matched to the role and better supported once hired



To Apply

Please submit the following:

1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A short paragraph describing your experience with:

   - Recruiting or talent acquisition

   - VA or remote talent hiring

   - HR / people operations (employee relations, performance management, policy, offboarding)

   - Managing hiring pipelines or recruiting metrics



Subject Line: Talent & HR Leader – [Your Full Name]



We are looking for a Talent & HR Leader who can build a strong, scalable recruiting function while also owning the people side of the employee lifecycle — from first endorsement through long-term retention.

title: Full Time AI Community Newsletter Writer and Content Creator and Curator
description:
We are looking for a talented, dependable, and creative **AI Community Newsletter Writer and Content Curator** to join our team full time.



Our company manages several active communities focused on artificial intelligence, entrepreneurship, professional development, and business growth. We are not looking for someone who simply writes generic newsletters. We need someone who can enter our communities, identify the most valuable conversations, interview our members, review training content, and turn everything into newsletters people are excited to open and read.



You will manage up to **five weekly community newsletters and one daily newsletter**.



## What You Will Do



- Write, edit, format, and prepare engaging newsletters for multiple communities

- Review
 Groups, Skool communities, live training sessions, event recordings, Zoom calls, transcripts, and other community content

- Identify important discussions, questions, wins, announcements, resources, and opportunities that should be featured

- Interview community members, instructors, experts, team members, and special guests

- Prepare thoughtful interview questions before each interview

- Review interview recordings and transcripts and turn them into compelling newsletter stories

- Use AI tools to summarize, organize, repurpose, edit, and improve content

- Highlight and celebrate community member accomplishments, breakthroughs, testimonials, launches, promotions, and business wins

- Create educational newsletter sections that teach readers something useful

- Find and feature relevant opportunities such as grants, speaking opportunities, events, jobs, partnerships, tools, programs, and business resources

- Turn live trainings and long form content into short, clear, actionable newsletter content

- Write strong subject lines, headlines, introductions, calls to action, and community announcements

- Maintain the unique voice and personality of each community

- Coordinate with our team to collect information, confirm details, and meet publishing deadlines

- Maintain an editorial calendar for all newsletters

- Track upcoming events, deadlines, promotions, and important community dates

- Proofread every newsletter carefully before submission

- Recommend new newsletter sections, story ideas, engagement strategies, and content improvements



## What We Are Looking For



You must be an excellent writer and storyteller who knows how to make information clear, useful, interesting, and easy to read.



You must also be:



- Highly proficient with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms

- Experienced in using AI without producing robotic, repetitive, or inaccurate writing

- Comfortable creating prompts and AI workflows for research, writing, editing, summarizing, and repurposing content

- Skilled at interviewing people and asking questions that uncover meaningful stories

- Able to work from audio recordings, video recordings, transcripts, notes, and community conversations

- Experienced with
 Groups, Skool, or other online community platforms

- Excellent in written English, grammar, spelling, editing, and proofreading

- Able to capture someone else’s brand voice instead of writing everything in the same style

- Highly organized and capable of managing multiple newsletters and deadlines at the same time

- Proactive and able to identify great content without waiting for someone to assign every story

- Comfortable communicating with community members in a warm, professional, and respectful manner

- Able to verify names, dates, links, opportunities, and factual information before publishing

- Dependable, responsive, detail oriented, and committed to meeting deadlines



## Our Newsletter Philosophy



Our newsletters should make community members feel informed, valued, inspired, and connected.



Every newsletter should include a thoughtful combination of:



- Community member celebrations

- Educational tips and practical lessons

- Highlights from trainings and community conversations

- Important announcements and upcoming events

- Valuable tools, resources, and recommendations

- Relevant business, career, speaking, funding, partnership, or growth opportunities

- Clear next steps that encourage members to participate



We want our readers to finish each newsletter feeling like they learned something, discovered an opportunity, and became more connected to the community.



## Work Schedule



This is a **full time, long term position**.



You must be able to manage up to five weekly newsletters and one daily newsletter while maintaining excellent quality and meeting every deadline.



Some availability during United States business hours will be required for team meetings, interviews, and communication. The remaining work may be completed during your regular working hours in the Philippines.



## Performance Expectations



Your success will be measured by:



- Newsletters being completed accurately and on time

- Quality of writing and storytelling

- Ability to find valuable stories and opportunities

- Member engagement with newsletter content

- Accuracy of names, links, dates, and information

- Ability to maintain the voice of each community

- Strong organization and communication with the team

- Consistent use of AI to improve efficiency without lowering quality



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A short introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for this role

2. Links or attachments to two or three writing samples

3. An example of a newsletter you have written, if available

4. A description of the AI tools you currently use and how you use them

5. An example of how you would turn a one hour training or interview transcript into newsletter content

6. Your experience interviewing people or writing profile stories

7. Your expected monthly salary for a full time position

8. Your availability and preferred working hours in Philippine Time

9. The words **Community Newsletter Pro** at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete job description



Applicants may be asked to complete a short paid writing test using a sample transcript or community discussion.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our company, become deeply familiar with our communities, and help us create newsletters that our members genuinely look forward to receiving.

We're looking for someone who can confidently speak with U.S.-based customers, turn inbound leads into booked jobs, solve problems without needing constant direction, and help ensure our daily cleaning operations run smoothly.



Your primary responsibility will be sales and converting inbound leads, but you'll also play an important role in operations, customer communication, scheduling, and social media.



If you're competitive, organized, dependable, and looking for a long-term opportunity where your responsibilities and income can grow with the company, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do:



SALES & CUSTOMER GROWTH

* Follow up aggressively and professionally with warm leads by phone, text, and

DAILY OPERATIONS

* Helping resolve last-minute scheduling changes or operational issues

* Coordinating new bookings with cleaner availability

* Following up with customers after their cleaning

* Identifying problems before they become bigger issues

SOCIAL MEDIA & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT

* Organizing customer photos and content

* Assisting with review generation and customer follow-up

* Helping with other projects as the company grows

* Experienced in phone sales, appointment setting, closing, or high-converting customer service

* Comfortable asking for the sale

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Calm under pressure and good at solving problems

* Able to manage multiple conversations and priorities at once

* Dependable and punctual

* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently

* Coachable and interested in improving

* Comfortable being measured on performance and results

Technical Requirements

* Reliable computer

* Wired high-speed internet connection of at least 30 Mbps

* Quiet, professional workspace with minimal background noise

* High-quality headset and microphone

* Backup internet connection

* Backup computer/device in case of emergencies

Compensation

PLUS:



* Uncapped sales commissions

* Performance bonuses

* Opportunities for raises based on performance

* Opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement as the company grows

Schedule

* Must be available during U.S. business hours

* Schedule will follow Pacific Time (California)

Why Join SoCal Signature Clean?

* Take on more responsibility as you prove yourself

How to Apply
