title: Short-Form Video Editor — TikTok, YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels
description:
We are looking for a **Short-Form Video Editor** to join our content team and help grow our social media presence across **YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels**.



### Job Details



**Niche:** Forex Trading, Investing & Financial Education

**Content:** TikTok, YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels

**Volume:** Approximately **28 short-form videos per month**

**Content Breakdown:**



* ~24 clips repurposed from long-form YouTube content

* ~4 original personality/strategy clips

  **Video Length:** Generally 20–60 seconds

  **Turnaround:** 24–48 hours per batch/video depending on workload

  **Rate:** **$3 per finished short**, depending on complexity

  **Duration:** Long-term relationship



Hey there! Thanks for checking out our job post.



I'm looking for a short-form editor who understands that creating Shorts isn't just about cutting a long video into vertical format.



The goal is to create **scroll-stopping content that grabs attention quickly, keeps viewers engaged, and ultimately drives people toward my YouTube channel.**



My channel focuses on forex trading, swing trading, market analysis, trading psychology, educational content, and trading challenges.



I'm looking for someone who understands **hooks, pacing, retention, captions, storytelling, and short-form content trends.**



I'm not looking for overly flashy edits just for the sake of being flashy. I want the editing to feel modern, engaging, clean, and natural while still giving viewers a reason to keep watching.



## Content Strategy



The monthly workflow will consist of approximately **28 Shorts**:



### 1. Long-Form Repurposing — ~24 Shorts



I will provide long-form YouTube content that can be turned into multiple short-form clips.



You should be able to identify the strongest moments, hooks, lessons, opinions, or entertaining sections and turn them into standalone Shorts.



The clips should make sense **without requiring someone to watch the full YouTube video first.**



### 2. Native Short-Form Content — ~4 Shorts



These will be specifically recorded for short-form content.



These may include:



* Trading tips

* Strategy explanations

* Trading psychology

* Quick market insights

* Personal opinions

* Personality-driven content

* Educational concepts



These should feel native to TikTok/Reels/Shorts rather than simply feeling like shortened YouTube videos.



## Responsibilities



* Turn long-form YouTube content into engaging short-form videos

* Identify strong moments and potential hooks

* Create compelling openings within the first few seconds

* Remove unnecessary pauses, filler words, and dead space

* Add clean, engaging captions

* Highlight important words or phrases

* Use zooms, cuts, B-roll, sound effects, and motion graphics when appropriate

* Reframe footage properly for **9:16 vertical format**

* Maintain strong pacing throughout the video

* Make educational content easy to understand

* Create edits that feel native to TikTok, Shorts, and Reels

* Add subtle visual effects that improve retention without becoming distracting

* Include a CTA toward the YouTube channel when appropriate

* Maintain consistent branding across all short-form content



## What I'm Looking For



The ideal editor understands:



**HOOK ? VALUE ? RETENTION ? CTA**



You should know how to take something like:



> "Here's something most beginner traders don't understand..."



and turn it into an opening that makes someone want to keep watching.



I'm looking for someone who can recognize the **most interesting part of a conversation or lesson** and build the Short around that moment.



## Editing Style



I want the content to feel:



* Clean

* Modern

* Engaging

* Fast-paced when appropriate

* Easy to follow

* Personality-driven

* Professional

* Native to short-form platforms



I don't want every second filled with effects.



**Good pacing and storytelling are more important than excessive effects.**



Captions should be visually engaging but still easy to read.



## Requirements



* Previous experience editing TikTok, Instagram Reels, and/or YouTube Shorts

* Strong understanding of short-form audience retention

* Ability to create strong hooks

* Experience with captions and on-screen text

* Understanding of 9:16 vertical video

* Experience with Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software

* Strong communication skills

* Reliable turnaround times

* Fluent or advanced English

* Willing to accept feedback and continuously improve

* Ability to identify strong moments from long-form content independently



## Bonus



You will stand out if you:



* Have experience editing content in the **finance, trading, investing, or educational niche**

* Understand trading terminology

* Have experience growing short-form content

* Understand TikTok/Instagram/YouTube Shorts trends

* Can suggest better hooks or ways to structure a clip

* Understand how to create content that funnels viewers toward long-form YouTube videos



## About Our Channel



Our channel focuses on **forex trading, swing trading, market analysis, trading psychology, educational content, and trading challenges.**



The goal of our short-form content is not just to get views.



We want to use Shorts, TikTok, and Reels to:



**Grow the audience ? Build trust ? Get people interested in the content ? Drive viewers toward the YouTube channel.**



We're building a long-term brand and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



**YouTube Channel:** ElevateWithAK


)



## To Apply



Please include:



* Your rate per short-form video

* Your short-form editing portfolio

* 3–5 examples of TikToks, Reels, or YouTube Shorts you've edited

* What editing software you use

* Your average turnaround time

* Whether you have experience editing finance, trading, investing, or educational content

* Your availability for approximately 28 videos per month



To show you've read this entire job description, begin your application with the words:



**"Break and Retest."**



Applications that don't include this will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a **long-term partnership** and help grow the ElevateWithAK brand across short-form platforms.

title: Community Research & Engagement  Specialist
description:
Community Research & Engagement Specialist — Reddit

Remote — Philippines

Part-Time: 10–15 hours/week

$5 - 7  USD/hour depending on experience

This isn't a typical social-media job.

We're a growing U.S. oral-health and wellness company looking for someone who is exceptionally curious about people and the questions they ask online.

Every day, thousands of people go online worried about their health.

They're scared. They're confused. They're embarrassed to ask a question. Sometimes they simply want someone to explain something in a way they can understand.

We want to listen to them and help.

Your primary focus will be Reddit.

You'll find real conversations about oral health, gum disease, bleeding gums, dental anxiety, dental cleanings, bad breath, oral bacteria, saliva and other oral-health concerns.

But we don't just want to know what they're asking.

We want to understand why they're asking it.

Your Job

You'll spend approximately 10–15 hours each week:

Searching Reddit for relevant conversations and questions

Reading and understanding what people are worried about

Identifying the question behind the question

Categorizing questions, fears and recurring themes

Researching credible information

Drafting warm, thoughtful responses

Tracking conversations in Google Sheets

Following responses and identifying new questions

Preparing a short weekly report about what you're learning

What You Will NOT Do

This is extremely important.

You will not spam Reddit.

You will not copy and paste promotional messages.

You will not pretend to be a customer.

You will not secretly promote our company.

You will not diagnose anyone or give individualized medical treatment advice.

And you will not try to turn every conversation into a sale.

Our philosophy is simple:

Listen first.

Understand second.

Help third.

Marketing comes much later.

Who We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if:

Your written English is exceptional

You understand natural American conversation

You're empathetic and emotionally intelligent

You're naturally curious

You're a strong internet researcher

You can distinguish credible information from questionable claims

You are comfortable using Google Sheets

You understand Reddit culture—or are willing to learn it

You can write like a human, not a corporate marketing department

You know when a question should be escalated rather than answered

Healthcare, dental, wellness, research, customer-service or community-management experience is helpful but not required.

We're much more interested in how you think and communicate.

HOW TO APPLY

Please don't send us a generic cover letter.

Instead, answer these three questions:

1. Someone posts on Reddit:

"I brush twice a day and floss. My dentist just told me I have gum disease. How is that even possible? I'm really upset."

Write exactly how you would respond.

2. Someone posts:

"I haven't been to the dentist in eight years because I'm terrified they're going to judge me. I know I need to go, but I can't make myself do it."

Write exactly how you would respond.

3. Someone asks you a health question and you're not confident that you know the correct answer.

What would you do?

Finally, begin your application with the words:

I READ THE ENTIRE POST

Applications that don't include those words will not be considered.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just see a Reddit post.

We want someone who sees the person behind it.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer - TypeScript / Cloudflare Workers (Long Term, Claude Code)
description:
READ THIS FIRST.

Your application must open with these four lines, in this order. Anything that does not gets deleted unread.



Line 1 - A Cloudflare Worker enforces a rate limit by counting requests in a plain JavaScript Map declared at module scope. In production it lets through many times more requests than the limit allows. Why? One or two sentences.



Line 2 - Tell me about a time one customer could see another customer's data, either a bug you shipped or one you found in someone else's code. What the bug was, and what you changed so it could not happen again. If it has never happened to you, say so honestly.



Line 3 - A link to code you actually wrote. GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, a gist. Not a portfolio website, not a resume PDF.



Line 4 - How many hours per day you can overlap with Pacific time (Vancouver, UTC-7), and the monthly rate in USD you want.



THE PRODUCT

Alvero is a dental practice management platform I have been building. It is live and used every day by real clinics in Canada - staff portals, patient portals, scheduling, messaging, SMS and voice automation, and an integration with a legacy on-premise dental database. It is not a prototype and it is not a side project. When it breaks, a front desk cannot book a patient.



THE ROLE

I need one engineer to take it from where it is now to finished, and then keep it running. This is not a project with an end date. It is a job.



- Build the remaining features to launch quality

- Fix production issues, including the ones only one clinic ever sees

- Onboard new clinics onto the platform and sort out whatever breaks for them specifically

- Own the unglamorous parts: migrations, deploys, logs, alerts, dependency upgrades

- Write the small tools that stop the same problem coming back a third time



THE STACK

- TypeScript everywhere, strict mode

- React with Vite for the portals, some Next.js

- Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, Pages, Wrangler

- Supabase and Postgres, row level security, multi tenant

- GitHub Actions for CI and deploys

- Twilio for SMS, Anthropic Claude API for the AI features

- I work on Windows and PowerShell, so scripts have to run there



You do not need every item on that list. You do need to be genuinely strong in TypeScript and SQL, and honest about the rest.



HOW I WORK

I use Claude Code every day and so will you. I am not looking for someone who pastes AI output and hopes. I am looking for someone who reviews it the way they would review a junior developer's pull request, and who can tell when it is confidently wrong. If you have never used an AI coding tool seriously, this is the wrong post for you.



Small changes, pull requests, no direct pushes to main. If you break production you tell me immediately, before I find out from a clinic. I would rather have boring code that works than clever code I get woken up for.



REQUIREMENTS

- 4 or more years writing production software, not tutorials and not agency landing pages

- TypeScript and SQL you can defend in a live conversation, screen shared

- You have carried something you built into production and supported it afterwards

- Full time, long term. I am hiring one person for years, not for one sprint.

- Written English good enough that your bug reports need no editing from me

- Reliable power and internet, and a machine that can actually run a dev environment



NICE TO HAVE

- Cloudflare Workers or another edge runtime

- Multi tenant SaaS, where one bad query leaks another tenant's data

- Healthcare, dental, or anything else with real privacy rules

- Integrating a legacy database nobody documented - ODBC, raw SQL, vendor APIs



HEALTH DATA

This platform handles patient information under Canadian privacy law. You will sign a confidentiality agreement. Development is done against synthetic data, never real patient records. If handling health information carefully sounds like an annoyance rather than part of the job, please do not apply.



PAY

1,800 to 2,600 USD per month, full time, depending on what you can actually do. Paid monthly, on time, reviewed at six months.



HOW HIRING WORKS

Applications that follow the four lines get read. Everything else is deleted. Shortlisted people get a short technical exercise, about 45 minutes, on a self contained problem - a piece of TypeScript to fix and a SQL question. Then a live screen share where you walk me through your own code.



Do not send me a generic cover letter. I have read hundreds of them.

title: Bodycam Arrest Researcher
description:
FOIA Researcher Needed — Bodycam True Crime Channel (Ongoing, 2 Cases/Week) I run a true crime YouTube channel focused on bodycam and interrogation footage, and I'm looking for an experienced FOIA researcher to source cases on an ongoing basis. What I need: You will deliver two (2) fully sourced cases per week. Each case must include enough material to support a 20–40 minute video. In practice, that means:



Bodycam, dashcam, and/or interrogation footage already obtained (not "requestable" — obtained) For each video file: exact runtime clearly stated Strong narrative potential: the case needs a story worth telling — an arc, a twist, escalation, an unusual outcome. Not routine traffic stops or generic arrests. If the footage is long but nothing happens, it's not a case. A short case summary (who, what, where, outcome/current status)



Supporting documents (police reports, court records, 911 audio) are appreciated but not required — footage and story come first. Case freshness matters: Strong preference for recent cases that haven't already been covered on YouTube. Before pitching a case, do a quick search — if the footage is already uploaded on multiple channels, I'm not interested. Fresh FOIA releases and under-the-radar cases are exactly what I'm looking for. Hard requirements — read before applying:



I will not accept pitches like "I can get footage from X case" without specifying the exact runtime of the footage and what actually happens in it. If you don't know what the material looks like, don't pitch it. Footage must be public record and legally obtained through FOIA / public records requests. No leaked or pirated material. Consistency matters more than one-off finds. This is a weekly, long-term collaboration.



To apply, send: Include the word Chocolate in your application, One example case you could deliver right now, including footage runtime and a 2-3 sentence summary of why it makes a good video Your experience with FOIA / public records requests (which states/agencies you've worked with) Your rate per case or per week. I prefer Midwest Safety style bodycam cases. 



Applications that don't include footage runtime and case details will be ignored.

# Social Media & Marketing Manager — Aesthetics Clinic & Academy



We are looking for a reliable, creative and proactive **Social Media & Marketing Manager**, preferably with previous experience or strong knowledge of the **aesthetics, beauty, skincare or cosmetic treatment industry**.



You will be responsible for growing the online presence of both our **aesthetics clinic and training academy**, attracting new clients and students, promoting our treatments and courses, and building awareness within London.

*

*

 groups and communities



## Full Responsibilities



### Social Media Management

* Turn treatment footage, educational information, FAQs, client-approved content and clinic footage into engaging social media content.

* Develop content designed to turn followers into genuine enquiries and bookings.

* Create educational content that builds trust and demonstrates the clinic's expertise.

* Help promote new treatments, special campaigns and clinic announcements.

* Ensure treatment-related marketing is accurate and avoids misleading or inappropriate claims.



### Academy & Course Marketing



* Promote our aesthetics training courses and academy.

* Create content aimed at potential students who are interested in entering or developing within the aesthetics industry.

* Promote upcoming training dates and course availability.

* Showcase appropriate behind-the-scenes training content and student experiences where permission has been obtained.

* Create educational posts explaining courses, training opportunities and what students can expect.

* Help generate enquiries and potential student leads through social media.



### London Community Promotion



* Research and join relevant **London
 groups and local online communities**.

* Engage genuinely with local discussions and identify appropriate opportunities to introduce our clinic or academy.

* Promote the business in groups where business advertising is permitted.

### Content Creation & Editing



* Perform basic editing of Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts.

* Add appropriate subtitles, text, hooks and calls-to-action to videos.

* Create simple social media graphics and promotional material when required.

* Organize raw videos, edited videos, photos, graphics and completed posts within **iCloud**.

* Maintain clearly labelled folders so content can easily be found and reused.



### Growth & Strategy



* Develop separate social media strategies for the **clinic** and **academy**.

* Research aesthetics and beauty trends that could be relevant to our audience.

* Monitor competitors, particularly successful aesthetics clinics and academies in London.

* Research trending content formats, hooks and ideas.

* Suggest new campaigns and content ideas rather than waiting to be told what to post.

* Focus on meaningful results such as enquiries, bookings and academy leads—not only followers and likes.



### Analytics & Reporting



* Provide a **daily analytics screenshot** showing performance.

* Track reach, views, engagement, follower growth, enquiries and other relevant metrics.

* Provide a simple **weekly performance summary** explaining:



  * Best-performing content

  * Lowest-performing content

  * Follower growth

  * Reach and engagement

  * Enquiries/leads generated

  * What should be changed or tested the following week

* Use performance data to continually improve the content strategy.



## Must-Have

* **Knowledge or experience within aesthetics, beauty, skincare, cosmetic treatments or a closely related industry is strongly preferred.**

* Good understanding of Instagram, TikTok,
 and short-form video.

* Experience generating local leads for London businesses.

Experience running

Shopify

Copywriting portfolio

Answer all nine questions below in your reply. Applications that skip questions will not be reviewed.

You may not independently send follow-up messages, publish social posts, schedule posts to go live, boost content, reply as Dan or send direct messages. Dan must approve every outbound batch before publication or sending.



THE NAEA-ALIGNED PERSON WE WANT

- Growth mindset: actively asks for feedback, accepts it and acts on it.

- Add value: looks for useful improvements for clients and teammates.

- 100/0 ownership: accepts responsibility and asks what could have been done differently.

- Open and real: communicates problems, disagreements and uncertainty respectfully.

- Strong professional English, attention to detail and solution-oriented problem solving.

- Positive, enthusiastic, dependable and respectful.

- Highest level of integrity with confidential information.

- Naturally curious and comfortable writing "not verified" rather than guessing.

- Able to follow scripts, checklists and defined processes without working mechanically.

- Able to manage focused work blocks, CRM documentation, follow-up tasks and daily reporting.

- Able to overlap at least three working hours with Mountain Time.



TOOLS YOU MAY LEARN

GoHighLevel, PropertyRadar, public county records, spreadsheets, knowledge-base tools, social scheduling tools and AI-assisted transcription and call-quality review. Experience with every tool is not required. Coachability, judgment, communication and accurate execution matter more.



TO APPLY

Put "accuracy before speed" in the first line and submit:

1. A 60-90 second audio introduction explaining your WHY and why this role fits you.

2. A brief example of feedback or criticism you received, what you changed and the result.

3. An example of a failure or missed deadline and what you could have done differently.

4. An example of when you added value or went the extra mile for a client or teammate.

5. A difficult record, CRM issue or research conflict you reconciled.

6. A sanitized spreadsheet, database or CRM sample with all confidential information removed.

7. One fictional or sanitized topic adapted into different
 and Instagram captions.

8. Your answer: What do you do when two reliable sources disagree?

9. How you organize focused work, CRM updates, follow-up tasks and daily reporting.

10. Your expected hourly rate, available Mountain Time hours, current weekly commitments, computer, internet speed and backup setup.



Finalists will complete the same paid synthetic-data audition and behavioral interview. Do not include private customer information, credentials or work samples owned by another employer.

title: Marketing Project Manager — Real Estate Dubai Market · Fully Remote
description:
About us



IMSOLD Agency is the agency arm of an AI-first venture studio. We don't run campaigns for clients and

hand over a report — we build and operate brands end to end: research, creative, funnels, media

buying, tech, and the teams that run them. Our portfolio spans health, wellness, B2B software, and

real estate across the US, Europe, and the Middle East.

This role sits on our Dubai real estate lead-generation account — a fast-moving operation

connecting property owners and investors with licensed Dubai real estate professionals.



About the role



You orchestrate the complete marketing flow of the brand — from verified research foundations to a

running content calendar — then hand off to production, which runs on our proprietary operations

platform.

You do not produce the work. Specialist teams handle research, copywriting, design, video, publishing,

and legal review. Your job is rather: to see the whole machine, verify that every input exists and is

sound before work starts, spot the missing dependency before it breaks something downstream, and

keep a dozen specialists in time. Six verbs describe the day-to-day: verify ? chase ? assemble ?

agree ? build ? hand off.



What you'll do



Verify the brand's marketing foundations — market and competitor research, audience definitions,

messaging inputs, legal constraints — and trigger the right specialist team when a layer is missing

or below the bar

Assemble all verified inputs into one content plan for the brand

Agree the content rhythm — channels, campaign mix, volume — directly with the brand's

leadership

Build the content calendar so that every slot has its creative, caption, call-to-action, and a

destination that actually exists

Hand off cleanly to production and keep the machine flowing: chase blockers, reconcile numbers,

route every creative through compliance review before launch

Quality-control what comes back: catch contradictions, impossible numbers, and unsourced claims

before they reach anyone downstream



What we're looking for



3+ years running performance-marketing, direct-response, or growth projects — owning the

system, not just executing tasks in it

Hands-on familiarity with paid social funnels (Meta especially): you don't have to be the media

buyer, but you must understand CPMs, CTR, CPL, and funnel math well enough to manage one

Proven ability to orchestrate a team of specialists to ship on deadline — and to tell someone their

work is broken when it is

An instinct for dependencies: you naturally order work by what must exist first, and you treat

"done" as something to verify, not something to accept

Fluent, precise written English — this is an async, remote, documentation-heavy environment



Real estate experience — a strong plus



Dubai / UAE property market experience

You've marketed in or to the Dubai real estate market — brokerage marketing, property portals or

proptech, developer marketing, or lead generation for UAE realtors — and you know its

advertising rules and market dynamics first-hand.



Property-market experience anywhere

You've run marketing operations or lead generation in any serious property market. The instincts

transfer; the Dubai specifics are teachable.



What this role is not



Not a real estate sales role — no transactions, no client calls, no commissions

Not a content-production role — you won't write scripts, design, or edit video

Not a media-buying role — specialists run the ads; you run the flow



What we offer



Fully remote work with high autonomy and high standards — you'll be trusted to run things, and

held to the results

A documented, systemized operation: you inherit a complete written playbook, not chaos

Exposure to a multi-brand venture studio and a modern AI-native marketing stack

Long-term growth: strong moderators take on additional brands across the portfolio



How to apply



Send your CV to 
 with the subject line "Marketing Project Manager — Real

Estate" and include, in the body of your message:



In exactly five sentences: describe one system or process you personally kept on the rails —

what its moving parts were, what broke most often, and how you caught it early

Your real estate / Dubai market experience, if any (be specific — markets, companies, campaigns)

Your monthly salary expectation and earliest start date



Applications that skip the five-sentence answer will not be reviewed — following the instruction is part of the test.

Shortlisted candidates complete a recorded 20–25 minute first-line interview conducted by our AI interviewer, followed by

a live assessment session and a paid trial task.

title: FBA/MFBA Specialist
description:
We are specifically looking for someone who has personally helped start an Amazon FBA business from the ground up. You must have previous hands-on experience taking an FBA business from product research and sourcing through launch and ongoing operations. SmartScout experience is required. Having Multi FBA setup will be great too

Amazon FBA Launch & Product Research Specialist – SmartScout Experience Required

- Experience in understanding the Amazon attribution process, Vine is required too

- Basic experience on how campaigns on Amazon works

We are looking for an experienced Amazon FBA specialist to help us build and launch a new Amazon FBA business from the ground up.

This is NOT an entry-level Amazon VA position. We want someone who has previously worked with successful Amazon FBA businesses and understands the entire process from product research and sourcing through launching products and managing Seller Central.

SmartScout experience is REQUIRED.

Responsibilities

Help develop our Amazon FBA business from the startup stage

Conduct detailed product and niche research using SmartScout

Identify profitable products and opportunities based on real data

Analyze:

Demand and estimated sales

Competition

Seller count

Pricing history

Profit margins

Amazon/FBA fees

ROI

BSR

Market saturation

Brand and category restrictions

Research competitors, brands, sellers, and categories

Identify suppliers, manufacturers, wholesalers, or sourcing opportunities

Help evaluate Wholesale, Online Arbitrage, and/or Private Label opportunities

Assist with setting up and managing Amazon Seller Central

Help with product listings, keywords, inventory, FBA shipments, and launch strategy

Create organized spreadsheets showing researched products and recommendations

Explain why a product should or should not be pursued

Help us build systems and SOPs that can eventually be delegated to additional team members

Required Experience

You should have:

2+ years of hands-on Amazon FBA experience preferred

Experience helping launch or grow an Amazon FBA business

Strong experience with SmartScout

Strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central

Experience with Amazon product research and sourcing

Understanding of FBA fees, margins, ROI, Buy Box, BSR, competition, and sales velocity

Ability to identify bad opportunities and potential risks before money is invested

Strong Google Sheets/Excel skills

Good written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail

Ability to work independently

Experience with Keepa, SellerAmp, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar Amazon tools is a plus.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can do more than follow instructions.

We want someone who can look at an opportunity, analyze the numbers, and tell us:

“This is a good product and here's why.”

or

“Don't invest in this product and here's what the data is showing.”

You should be comfortable helping an owner who is building a new Amazon business and providing guidance based on your previous experience.

There is an opportunity for this position to grow into an Amazon FBA Manager / Operations Manager role as the business grows.

Hours & Compensation

Starting: 20 hours per week

Pay: $6–$8 USD/hour depending on experience

Schedule: Flexible

Opportunity for increased hours, raises, and performance bonuses based on results.

How to Apply

Please answer ALL of the following:

How many years of Amazon FBA experience do you have?

Have you ever helped build or launch an Amazon FBA business from the beginning? Explain what you did.

How long have you used SmartScout?

Which SmartScout tools/features do you use most?

What other Amazon research tools have you used?

Walk us through how you determine whether a product is worth selling on Amazon.

Give an example of a profitable product or opportunity you discovered and explain how you found it.

Which Amazon FBA model do you have the most experience with: Wholesale, Online Arbitrage, Retail Arbitrage, or Private Label?

Are you comfortable helping create SOPs and systems as the business grows?

IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “SMARTSCOUT FBA” so we know you read the entire job description.

Please also include your resume and, if possible, screenshots or examples of previous Amazon product research with any confidential information removed.
